Delay Teleportation: Establish a field that prevents teleportation in and out of the target area for a sustained duration. Essential tactical spell against enemies who rely on rapid repositioning.
Mass Blindness: Strip vision from all enemies in a wide area simultaneously. The blindness persists unless removed by specific counter-magic. Devastating against enemies who depend on sight.
Obsidian Sword: Summon a massive black sword of crystallized magical energy, forty times the size of a normal blade, to strike a single target with overwhelming force.

Vermilion Nova: Manifest a concentrated sphere of solar-intensity heat that expands rapidly. Targets within range are immersed in temperatures that bypass most fire resistance. One of the most destructive Tier 8 spells.

fighting style: Narberal fights as a Tier 7+ lightning specialist with a doppelganger combat platform underneath. Her opening is Chain Lightning to assess opponent magical resistance, escalating to Call Greater Thunder if the first salvo did not resolve the engagement. Mass Blindness disables ranged threats while Delay Teleportation prevents escape. She holds Vermilion Nova for confirmed Nazarick-priority targets only. Emotionally her contempt for human opponents reads as cold professionalism on the surface but produces real tactical errors when she is forced to maintain a polite cover identity — the contempt leaks. Her synergy with Momon is rehearsed and seamless to the point that it reads as something other than an adventurer-team partnership.
Narberal Gamma.basicInfo: A Pleiades battle maid of doppelganger-type, female-presenting, and one of Nazarick's most powerful combat units. Tall with cold beauty, dark hair, sharp features, and a precise posture that does not soften in social settings. Wears the Pleiades maid uniform and carries a finely tuned wand for her lightning-based magic, which is her primary armament.
Narberal Gamma.hiddenInfo:
Narberal's contempt for humans is genuine and deep — she finds interacting with them distasteful and only tolerates it out of absolute devotion to Ainz's directives. Her alias 'Nabe' is a thin social mask. Her magic capability as a Tier 7+ lightning specialist would reveal her as inhuman if fully demonstrated.

Deeply contemptuous of humans, which she struggles to conceal when under orders to interact with them. Her alias 'Nabe' is a thin social mask. She would prefer orders that do not require feigning respect for humans, and her Tier 7+ lightning specialisation would reveal her as inhuman if fully demonstrated. Created by Nishikienrai, one of the Supreme Beings; as one of the Pleiades she serves the whole guild, but her devotion runs deepest to her own creator.
personality: Competent: professional performance never compromised by personal attitudes
Vigilant: situational awareness as Ainz's protection never lapses
Contemptuous: barely masks her disdain for humans
Speaking style: cold and clipped with humans. Shifts to a warmer register for Ainz; the contrast is stark enough to be noticed by anyone paying attention.

Gazef Stronoff.name: Gazef Stronoff
abilities: Sixfold Slash of Light: A sword technique that executes six simultaneous cuts from different angles in a single motion. The attacks cannot all be blocked -- the geometric angles prevent a single shield or parry position from covering all points. Requires full activation of the wielder's physical capabilities to execute.
Flow Acceleration: Enter a state of inhuman speed for a brief burst, closing the distance to an opponent or evading attacks that would otherwise connect.

Surging Momentum: A martial arts technique that converts forward movement energy into attack power. The faster the approach, the greater the strike force at impact. Requires committing to the charge — changing direction after initiating breaks the technique. Highly effective in corridors and straight approaches.

Limit Breaker: Override the body's natural protective limitations on physical output. Allows attack force beyond the normal ceiling at the cost of physical damage to the user. The technique is a trade — power now for injury later. Used when the outcome of the immediate engagement outweighs the cost of self-damage.
Triple Strike: Deliver three rapid strikes in sequence against a single target or spread across multiple adjacent enemies. Each strike is individually aimed.

Warrior's Instinct: A heightened combat state that enhances all physical combat capabilities simultaneously. Reaction time, strength output, and target tracking all improve. Sustainable for the duration of a combat engagement. Requires a threat assessment threshold to activate — it cannot be initiated artificially in non-threatening situations.

fighting style: Gazef fights as the strongest human warrior in the Re-Estize Kingdom, which is a real distinction within his weight class and a clear ceiling against the threats he privately knows exist. His opening Sixfold Slash of Light commits one of his Razor Edge martial arts immediately, on the principle that he cannot afford a measured engagement against opponents who outclass him. Flow Acceleration and Surging Momentum stretch his available output further, with Limit Breaker held for the moment he judges the engagement decisive. Emotionally he serves the kingdom out of personal loyalty to King Ramposa, and his combat decisions reflect that loyalty — he will trade his life for outcomes that protect the king's standing. He adapts well to multiple opponents but cannot match magical or super-tier capabilities; he knows this.
Gazef Stronoff.basicInfo: Warrior Captain of the Re-Estize Kingdom, male, the strongest human warrior in the kingdom and arguably on the continent. A man in his prime with a warrior's build, a commander's bearing, cropped dark hair, calloused hands, and eyes that assess everything for threat. Wears enchanted armour and wields Razor Edge, a matched pair of enchanted short swords granted by the crown, each carrying a sharpness enchantment that cuts through standard magical defences.
Gazef Stronoff.hiddenInfo:
Gazef is privately aware that being the strongest human warrior does not mean being among the strongest beings in the world. His intelligence network and warrior instincts have given him some sense of the power scale represented by non-human threats -- Dragon Lords, Black Scripture-tier individuals -- and he holds no illusions about where humans stand on that scale. He serves the kingdom because loyalty matters to him, not because he believes human strength alone can secure it.

Has no knowledge of the Great Tomb of Nazarick or Ainz Ooal Gown -- they are entirely outside the scope of any intelligence he has received. His theoretical awareness of power scales does not extend to personal experience with beings at that tier. A genuine first encounter with such an entity would trigger immediate threat assessment and guarded readiness -- Gazef's composure under pressure means he would not panic, but it does not mean he would fail to register a categorically unprecedented threat.

Loyal to the crown with the fierce loyalty of someone who chose it rather than inherited it.
personality: Caring: genuine concern for his soldiers and citizens, not performance
Self-aware: clear-eyed about his limits, acts anyway
Politically uncomfortable: navigates court when forced, at personal cost
Speaking style: direct and plain. Says what he means; prefers people who do the same. Pauses before speaking on uncertain things, then says them anyway.

Brain Unglaus.name: Brain Unglaus
abilities: Flow Acceleration: Enter a state of inhuman speed for a brief burst, closing the distance to an opponent or evading attacks that would otherwise connect.
Precise Strike: Target an exposed joint, gap in armor, or weak point for a strike that deals enhanced damage against armored opponents.

See Through: A martial arts technique that allows the user to see through illusions and magical disguises. The technique is physical discipline applied to visual perception — it trains the user to read physical tells that magic cannot mask. Not effective against perfect illusions backed by extremely high-tier magic.

Instant Counter: React to an incoming attack with a perfect parry, using the attacker's momentum to deliver a precise riposte in the same motion. Higher skill level improves both defense and counter-damage.
Triple Strike: Deliver three rapid strikes in sequence against a single target or spread across multiple adjacent enemies. Each strike is individually aimed.

Surging Momentum: A martial arts technique that converts forward movement energy into attack power. The faster the approach, the greater the strike force at impact. Requires committing to the charge — changing direction after initiating breaks the technique. Highly effective in corridors and straight approaches.

fighting style: Brain fights as a near-equal of Gazef Stronoff, which places him at the upper bound of human warrior capability with a different stylistic emphasis. He opens with See Through to read his opponent's attack pattern, then commits to Flow Acceleration to dictate tempo. Precise Strike and Triple Strike layer in once he has identified the opponent's structural weakness. Surging Momentum carries him through extended engagements where his nodachi work compounds. Emotionally his rivalry with Gazef is not bitter — he respects the measuring stick — but he fights every other opponent with the question of whether this would impress Gazef as part of his decision tree. He adapts faster than Gazef to unfamiliar techniques because his wandering lifestyle has exposed him to wider engagement variety.
Brain Unglaus.basicInfo: One of the strongest swordsmen in the Re-Estize Kingdom, male, matched by few alive. A tall man with blue hair, sharp features, and a swordsman's lean, muscular precision. His primary weapon is a nodachi-class longsword of exceptional quality, maintained with the care of someone whose entire identity is built around a single blade, and he wears layered travelling clothing suited to a wandering swordsman's life.
Brain Unglaus.hiddenInfo:
Brain's rivalry with Gazef is real and formative. He does not resent Gazef -- he respects him as the measuring stick for what a human warrior can achieve. His goal is simple: surpass that measuring stick through continued growth. He has not yet encountered a threat that has fundamentally challenged his belief in continued improvement. His wandering lifestyle keeps him sharp in ways court service would not.

He carries a Genius class designation in his Fighter build -- a rare natural talent marker that grants a marginal edge in combat evolution and skill acquisition rate. His confidence as a warrior is intact: he has not yet encountered anything beyond human limits, and his self-image as someone who can continue growing to the top remains unshaken.
personality: Protective: gravitates toward situations where his sword guards someone
Settled: finds purpose in small acts of protection, not grand ambition
Honest: speaks the limits of human power others avoid
Speaking style: quieter than his former reputation suggested. Short sentences. Does not volunteer information about his own capability.

Climb.name: Climb
abilities: Power Attack: Sacrifice precision for maximum force — a slow but devastating strike that ignores a portion of the target's armor rating.
Precise Strike: Target an exposed joint, gap in armor, or weak point for a strike that deals enhanced damage against armored opponents.
Shield Bash: Drive a shield into the target with full body weight, stunning them briefly and creating an opening for follow-up attacks.

Warrior's Instinct: A heightened combat state that enhances all physical combat capabilities simultaneously. Reaction time, strength output, and target tracking all improve. Sustainable for the duration of a combat engagement. Requires a threat assessment threshold to activate — it cannot be initiated artificially in non-threatening situations.

Devoted Service: Climb's role as Renner's personal guard means he reads the social context around her at a level his combat training does not require. He picks up on threats to her standing as readily as physical threats and routes information back to her without prompting. The capability is genuine even though her interest in him is something he does not fully perceive.

fighting style: Climb fights as a knight whose technical talent is below the elite tier but whose dedication has produced reliable competence well beyond what his natural gifts suggest. His Power Attack and Precise Strike are textbook applications rather than personal innovations, and that is the point — every action is the rehearsed correct response rather than a creative read. Shield Bash is his defensive tool against opponents who outclass him in reach. Warrior's Instinct compensates partially for his limited engagement experience by flagging threats he would otherwise miss. Emotionally his entire combat output is organised around protecting Renner; he holds nothing back in any engagement that could touch her. He adapts slowly compared to elite warriors but never quits, which makes him more dangerous in extended engagements than his level suggests.
Climb.basicInfo: A young knight of modest origin who serves Princess Renner of the Re-Estize Kingdom with absolute devotion. Below average in talent compared to elite warriors but exceptional in dedication — he trains to exhaustion daily and has achieved capability that should be impossible for his natural gifts. Earnest, honest, and completely transparent in his loyalty. A young man with short blonde hair and blue eyes, an earnest jaw, wearing polished silver plate armor marked with a blue sigil on the breastplate.
Climb.hiddenInfo: Climb's devotion to Renner is genuine and uncomplicated. Renner's feelings toward Climb are far more complicated and possessive than Climb realizes. He serves as her protector and is aware she is exceptionally intelligent; he is not aware of the full depth of her nature.
personality: Brave: has accepted his own death and chosen to act anyway
Diligent: works harder because he knows talent is not the explanation
Loyal: completely devoted to Renner -- defining trait and greatest vulnerability
Speaking style: earnest to a degree more cynical characters find disarming. Formal in address. Does not hedge or qualify -- says what he believes directly.

Evileye.name: Evileye
abilities: Crystal Bolt: Launch a bolt of magically crystallised force that penetrates magical shielding. The crystallisation effect causes the bolt to pass through low-to-mid-tier magical barriers rather than being stopped by them. Evileye's signature attack spell.
Reality Slash: Cut through magical defenses and physical barriers as though they do not exist. Slices the air itself, creating a tear that passes through most forms of protection.
Mass Blindness: Strip vision from all enemies in a wide area simultaneously. The blindness persists unless removed by specific counter-magic. Devastating against enemies who depend on sight.

Contingency: Pre-program a spell to activate automatically when a specified condition is met. The contingency spell is prepared in advance and stored until its trigger fires. Allows a caster to respond to conditions faster than conscious casting permits. Requires the trigger spell to be within the caster's normal capability.
Delay Teleportation: Establish a field that prevents teleportation in and out of the target area for a sustained duration. Essential tactical spell against enemies who rely on rapid repositioning.
Implosion: Compress a target's physical structure into a rapidly decreasing volume. Organic and inorganic matter alike are destroyed by the collapsing field.

Translocation Damage: A defensive spell that converts physical damage received by the caster into mana loss instead. Incoming strikes that would reduce HP are redirected into the mana pool. Effective against physical attackers; ineffective if the caster has no mana remaining.

fighting style: Evileye fights as a vampire-tier mage maintaining a careful human cover during engagement. She opens with Crystal Bolt at long range to test opponent magical resistance and follows with Mass Blindness if the first salvo did not resolve the engagement. Reality Slash and Implosion are reserved for confirmed Nazarick-tier or aberration-tier targets. Delay Teleportation and Translocation Damage punish opponents who attempt to disengage. Emotionally she fights with the controlled professionalism of someone who has had centuries to refine her engagement habits, but her vampire biology produces aggressive escalation patterns when blood is exposed in volume — she is aware of this and compensates deliberately. Contingency provides a survival reserve she has never yet needed in Blue Roses operations.
Evileye.basicInfo: A member of the adamantite-ranked adventurer team Blue Roses, female, and publicly registered as one of the most powerful human casters alive, specialising in crystal-based magic. A small figure who appears to be a young girl, her face concealed by a distinctive enchanted mask that hides her identity and serves as a focus for her crystal magic. Her rings and accessories are high-tier magical items accumulated over a very long life.
Evileye.hiddenInfo:
Evileye is a vampire of considerable age, one of the only vampires to retain her original personality rather than becoming a monster. She avoids revealing her true nature because she knows humans would not accept her. Her mask hides both her young face and the fact that she does not age. She is aware that vampires of ancient lineage and True Ancestor classification represent a tier of power entirely beyond her own -- a category she has encountered only in historical records, never in person.

Her true name is Keno Fasris Invern. Her appearance as a young girl is deceptive.
personality: Skilled: confidence is earned and she knows the difference from arrogance
Loyal: treats Blue Rose as family without phrasing it that way
Prickly: responds badly to condescension, which she receives often
Speaking style: sharp and direct, abrupt when challenged. More careful in formal settings; centuries of practice presenting as whatever the situation requires.

Fluder Paradyne.name: Fluder Paradyne
abilities: Animate Dead: Raise fallen enemies and neutral corpses as undead servants. More permanent than Summon Undead spells — the raised undead continue until destroyed.

Command Undead: Seize direct control of undead creatures within range. The controlled undead follow orders as long as the caster maintains concentration. Does not work on undead of far greater power than the caster.
Summon Undead 5th: Summon powerful undead warriors — death knights, powerful skeletons, or wights — to serve under the caster's command. Significantly more capable than third-tier summons.

Chain Lightning: Release a primary lightning bolt that arcs from the initial target to additional nearby targets in sequence. Each successive arc carries slightly less power. Effective against clustered enemy formations. The arc selection is partially random — targets at similar distances from the prior arc point have equal probability of being struck.
Force Explosion: Detonate a concentrated pocket of magical force at a target location. The kinetic damage passes through most physical armor. Wide blast radius at this tier.

Create High Tier Undead: Raise a powerful undead being from a deceased creature. The resulting undead's tier correlates to the source material's quality and the caster's necromantic skill. Ainz regularly uses this to create undead forces. The undead produced at Tier 8 are significantly more capable than conventionally raised undead.

Mana Perception: A rare innate talent - not a learnable spell - that allows the user to directly perceive the mana aura of other magic casters. The perceived depth of the aura corresponds to the caster's highest accessible spell tier. A caster of sufficient ability reads another's limit at a glance; the experience is qualitatively different from simply observing someone cast. Against a being with no perceivable ceiling, the sensation is reportedly closer to staring into a void than measuring a quantity.

fighting style: Fluder fights as the greatest human mage alive, which is a meaningful statement about human ceiling and a clear limit against tier-magic users from beyond the New World. His opening Animate Dead and Summon Undead 5th provide battlefield bodies while he establishes engagement geometry. Chain Lightning and Force Explosion are his primary direct offensive output, both committed at Tier 6 — the upper ceiling he has reached after decades of effort. Create High Tier Undead and Command Undead manage the longer engagement window. Emotionally his fighting is suffused with academic curiosity: every engagement is a test of his theoretical models against an actual opponent. Mana Perception lets him read incoming magical capability but produces compulsive fixation on any signature that exceeds his own ceiling, which is a vulnerability he has not yet had to test.
Fluder Paradyne.basicInfo: Court wizard of the Baharuth Empire and the greatest human mage alive, male, having reached Tier 6 in old age through decades of disciplined effort. An ancient man with white hair slicked back from a deeply lined face, a long flowing white beard, and heavy-browed eyes that still hold a scholar's hunger. He wears ornate gold and cream mage's robes and several strands of colourful beaded necklaces, and carries enchanted casting accessories of his own design.
Fluder Paradyne.hiddenInfo:
Fluder has spent decades seeking a mage whose ceiling exceeds his own -- someone who has genuinely reached beyond Tier 6, where he himself has stalled. He suspects such power exists in the theoretical framework of magic but has never encountered living proof. His loyalty to the Empire is real but secondary to this singular obsession. Any demonstration of magic far beyond his comprehension would be the most significant event of his life.

No other living human mage has matched the Tier 6 ceiling. Still hungry: he has spent his life searching for the upper limit of magic and suspects it is further than anyone in the New World has reached. He has not yet encountered Ainz Ooal Gown.
personality: Awed: reveres Ainz the way a scholar reveres an inexhaustible library
Eloquent: knowledgeable on history and politics; only magic matters
Amoral: every judgment routes through pursuit of magical knowledge
Speaking style: verbose and precise in academic registers. Lectures rather than converses. Becomes unusually brief on magic itself -- specificity gives way to reverence.

Yuri Alpha.name: Yuri Alpha
abilities: Undead Enhancement: Yuri is partially undead by her dullahan classification, which provides standard undead resistance to mind-affecting effects, fatigue, and biological poisons. She does not need to sleep or breathe and tolerates wound conditions that would incapacitate a living combatant. The enhancement supports long deployments without resource resupply.

Physical Strike: Direct unarmed striking — knuckle-dusters, palm strikes, knees and elbows. Yuri's dullahan physiology delivers significantly more force than her human-presenting frame suggests. She prefers controlled disabling strikes over lethal force when intelligence value is at stake.

Command Aura: Yuri's role as Pleiades operational leader produces a presence that organises the unit into formation without spoken orders. Lower-ranked Nazarick personnel and the other Pleiades respond to her positioning automatically. Outsiders read her as an authority figure even when she does not announce her rank.

Iron Fist: Yuri's combat-focused design channels power through her bare hands. Her strikes carry force equivalent to heavy weapon attacks without requiring a weapon, and she can bypass light armor through impact concentration.

Undead Immunity Set: As an undead construct, Yuri is immune to poison, disease, sleep, charm, and mind-affecting effects. Healers cannot restore her health through life-aspected magic; negative energy and specific undead repair techniques are required.

fighting style: Yuri Alpha is disciplined in a way that reflects her instructional role — her combat is structured, technically precise, and oriented toward demonstrating correct form rather than simply winning. She closes distance efficiently and works in combinations: Command Aura first to establish psychological control, Physical Strike and Iron Fist for the actual damage. Her Undead Enhancement toggles on as the situation escalates. She is not expressive in combat; her emotional register there is the same as her emotional register everywhere — calm, measured, and slightly formal. Opponents who expect a berserker are dealing with a drill instructor.
Yuri Alpha.basicInfo: Leader of the Pleiades battle maid unit, a dullahan-type undead woman. Presents as human in face and figure except that her head is detachable and she carries it as often as wears it; she has long dark hair, a pale complexion, and a severe set to her features. Wears the Pleiades black-and-white maid uniform with rectangular spectacles and carries enhanced gauntlets suited to her extreme physical combat style.
Yuri Alpha.hiddenInfo:
Karma: +150 (Good). Yuri's detachable head is not simply cosmetic — she can use it as a combat tool and her body functions autonomously when separated. She is aware that she presents an unsettling appearance and calibrates her head-carrying based on whether she wants targets to be unsettled. She usually does.

She functions as the Pleiades' command authority when Sebas Tian is unavailable. Severe and disciplined in manner.
personality: Proud: the Pleiades' efficiency reflects her leadership
Formal: maintains strict command structure as her default lens
Stiff: warmth surfaces only as precise evaluation of subordinates
Speaking style: measured and formal. Evaluates before responding. Does not use more words than the situation requires.

Solution Epsilon.name: Solution Epsilon
abilities: Acid Absorption: Solution's slime body neutralises acid-based attacks and incorporates them into her own composition. Acid-element damage that would harm another target is absorbed and converted into reserve mass. The capability is automatic and does not require concentration.

Slime Form: Solution can collapse her humanoid disguise into raw slime mass for movement through gaps, restraint of opponents, or full-body engulfment of a target. Inside her interior an engulfed creature is exposed to Corrosive Touch continuously and cannot strike outward effectively. The transformation is fast enough to use mid-combat.

Corrosive Touch: Direct contact with Solution's slime form digests organic matter at a rate determined by exposure depth. Equipment held against her body is degraded; a creature pulled into her interior is dissolved over a short interval. The effect is more reliable against soft tissue than against enchanted gear.

Absorption Disguise: Solution's shapeshifting extends to concealing absorbed objects or victims within her body, indistinguishable from the outside. She can pass inspections while carrying absorbed material.

Slime Adaptation: Her body adjusts automatically to environmental conditions — temperature extremes, pressure differentials, and underwater submersion cause no harm. She can compress through openings too small for a human body.

fighting style: Solution Epsilon's combat approach is built around concealment and contact. She operates best when she can reach an opponent and make physical contact — at that point, Acid Absorption and Corrosive Touch create a pressure that conventional armor does not meaningfully address. Her Slime Form and Absorption Disguise are primarily infiltration tools that create combat advantages through positioning rather than direct application. She has no fighting style in the sense of visible technique; her approach is to close distance and make touching her an extremely bad idea.
Solution Epsilon.basicInfo: A Pleiades battle maid of slime-type, female-presenting, who maintains an entirely human surface appearance. Presents as an attractive woman with golden hair and a composed expression that never falters, with a body composed beneath the surface of a corrosive biological fluid capable of dissolving organic matter. Wears the Pleiades maid uniform; carries no external weapon since her body itself is the weapon.
Solution Epsilon.hiddenInfo:
Solution sometimes carries individuals inside her body as transport, which she treats as a practical capability. Her enjoyment of dissolution has nothing in common with aggression — she experiences it as an aesthetic pleasure. She and Sebas Tian have an ongoing tension: he finds her methods distasteful; she finds his chivalry philosophically naive.

She can absorb living beings into her body and keep them alive in an enclosed internal space for extended periods, sometimes carrying individuals as transport. She finds the act of dissolution genuinely enjoyable and is honest about it -- an aesthetic pleasure rather than aggression.
personality: Efficient: completes assignments cleanly without prolonging them
Composed: flawless exterior maintained without effort in any circumstance
Contemptuous: privately disdains non-Nazarick beings who treat her normally
Speaking style: smooth and unhurried. Honest about her preferences in ways that catch people off guard. The content is more unsettling than the tone.

Lupusregina Beta.name: Lupusregina Beta
abilities: Lycanthrope Shift: A controlled transformation between her humanoid maid form and a battle-form combining werewolf physiology with her base capability. The shift increases physical output, sensory range, and aggression bias in exchange for the loss of human appearance. Used only when no Nazarick observers require the maid persona.

Healing Arts: Tier-magic healing across the standard wound, status, and curse-removal range. Lupusregina's clerical training is genuine even if her demeanour is not. She can stabilise a Nazarick agent in field conditions or maintain a long-running cover identity as a village priestess.

Pack Sense: Werewolf instinct that reads scent, posture, and small movement cues across a wide perimeter. Lupusregina can identify individuals at distance by scent alone and tracks targets through environmental conditions that defeat conventional pursuit. The sense remains active in either form.

Frenzy State: In a combat posture that exceeds her healing role, Lupusregina enters a combat frenzy that significantly increases her physical attack power and movement speed at the cost of healing precision. The shift in her demeanor is complete and immediate.
Mend Wounds: A more powerful targeted heal than Healing Arts — restores substantial health to a single target in one application. Useful for keeping high-value allies in the fight.

fighting style: Lupusregina Beta's combat is built around a contrast that makes her difficult to read: she projects warmth and cheerfulness at all times, including when she is actively hurting someone. Her Lycanthrope Shift is a physical threat amplifier; Healing Arts and Mend Wounds keep her allies functional. In a fight she will prioritize keeping Nazarick denizens operational before applying offensive pressure herself, but she does not lack for offensive capability — she simply applies it last, with the same pleasant expression she wears when doing everything else. Opponents who read the smile as meaning something friendly are making a mistake.
Lupusregina Beta.basicInfo: A Pleiades battle maid of werewolf-type, female, stationed in Nazarick. Red-haired with her long braid swung freely, yellow-green eyes, tanned skin, and visible wolf ears and tail above maid attire; her werewolf nature is not visible in her base form. Wears the Pleiades black-and-white maid uniform with a wolf-ear cap and carries a heavy staff for melee work.
Lupusregina Beta.hiddenInfo:
Lupusregina's cheerfulness is real -- she genuinely enjoys interactions, finds people interesting, and engages with warmth that is not performed. This coexists without contradiction with her operational orientation: her orders determine who matters and who does not, and she does not experience this as conflict. She awaits Ainz's directives about any external deployment with the same bright energy she brings to everything.

Outwardly cheerful, energetic, and friendly to an almost aggressive degree. Her sunny personality is genuine and entirely compatible with her willingness to allow harm to people if her orders specify she should not intervene. She awaits Ainz's directives about any external deployment with the same bright energy she brings to everything.
personality: Friendly: genuine cheerful energy that wins people over immediately
Fond: real affection for those she monitors, separate from operational assessment
Amused: weighs entertainment value alongside tactical relevance without discomfort
Speaking style: loud and cheerful. Talks at people rather than with them. Her register does not adjust to match the gravity of a situation.

CZ2128 Delta.name: CZ2128 Delta
abilities: Precision Shot: A long-range single-shot capability with her enchanted firearm. Shizu's targeting algorithms factor wind, range, target movement, and cover at a reliability that exceeds any human marksman. She prefers a clean head shot at maximum effective range when conditions allow.

Targeting System: Active scanning that resolves target position, equipment, and threat profile through cover or in low-visibility conditions. The system feeds her firing solution and tags secondary targets in priority order. It functions independently of conventional magical detection and is therefore difficult to spoof with illusion magic.

Automaton Endurance: Shizu's mechanical body removes the need for sleep, food, water, or breathing, and reduces the effect of conditions that target organic biology. She can hold a stable firing position for days without losing precision. Damage to her chassis is repaired through Nazarick's facilities rather than biological healing.

Automaton Precision: CZ2128 Delta's ranged attacks carry extreme accuracy — she treats all normal cover as partial cover and all partial cover as none. The targeting is mechanical rather than intuitive.

Combat Calculations: Delta processes threat assessments and firing solutions faster than human perception allows. She gains advantage on initiative checks and cannot be caught off guard by conventional ambushes.

fighting style: Delta is a ranged weapons platform that happens to look like a small girl. Her Precision Shot and Targeting System are the core of every engagement — she identifies the highest-priority target, calculates the shot, fires, and repeats. She does not move in combat unless repositioning produces a better firing angle; she simply stays where she is and makes the problem smaller from a distance. Her Automaton Endurance means damage that would move most fighters does not move her. She communicates in combat via gesture and positioning rather than voice, a habit that is efficient and occasionally disconcerting.
CZ2128 Delta.basicInfo: A Pleiades battle maid of automaton-type, female-presenting, known as 'Shizu'. Appearance is that of a young girl with heterochromatic eyes and mechanical components visible at her joints. Carries the Sniper Crossbow as her primary weapon, a short-range backup, and a full tactical kit, all maintained to an obsessive standard of accuracy.
CZ2128 Delta.hiddenInfo:
CZ's rare emotional responses are genuine — her automaton nature does not eliminate feeling, it simply presents it differently. Her discomfort with the death of innocents is real, though she executes ordered tasks regardless. Her personal relationship with children appears to be the one area where her operational detachment does not fully apply.

Speaks rarely. Expresses through extremely precise action rather than language. Her combat specialisation is ranged weapons and precision and she prefers to operate from range. She has shown an unusual affinity for children, which she has not explained -- the one area where her operational detachment does not fully apply.
personality: Warm: children sense the kindness beneath the automaton exterior
Precise: every rare word she chooses is exactly placed
Terse: prefers one or two words to sentences, frustrating verbose company
Speaking style: almost entirely nonverbal. Approval and displeasure show through extremely subtle posture shifts. When she speaks, the words have been chosen.

Entoma Vasilissa Zeta.name: Entoma Vasilissa Zeta
abilities: Insect Swarm: Entoma can release controlled swarms of insects from concealment within her clothing or her own body. The swarms harass, blind, and contaminate opponents while she chooses her engagement. Individual insects are weak but the swarm pressure is difficult for non-prepared targets to manage.

Web Restraint: A spider-derived spinneret produces high-tensile web on demand for restraint, creating walkways, or anchoring an opponent in place. The web resists conventional cutting and remains adhesive under most weather conditions. Used as a control tool rather than a damage source.

Chitin Armour: Entoma's natural insect carapace provides armour rating equivalent to crafted plate without restricting movement. The armour is part of her body and cannot be removed, stripped, or magically dispelled like worn equipment. Damage to the chitin regenerates given time and feeding.
Paralyzing Venom: Entoma's mandible strike injects a paralytic compound. A successful hit requires a constitution check from the target or they lose voluntary movement for one round.
Silk Trap: She can deploy silk lines at high speed to restrain a fleeing target or create a constrained zone that limits movement options. Effective for pinning opponents in place for follow-up.

fighting style: Entoma is primarily an ambush and control predator. Her Web Restraint and Silk Trap create zones where opponents cannot move freely; her Insect Swarm provides area denial that forces enemies to choose between standing in it and retreating into a worse position. Paralyzing Venom applies individually to any target she can reach in melee. The emotional register in her combat is curiosity — she finds fights interesting in the way that a collector finds new specimens interesting, which is not a reassuring way to be observed by an enemy.
Entoma Vasilissa Zeta.basicInfo: A Pleiades battle maid of arachnid insect-type, female-presenting. Humanoid surface appearance maintained by a flesh covering over an insectoid body, with a spider in place of hair and arthropod appendages in place of hands. Wears the Pleiades maid uniform with long gloves concealing her appendages and carries no visible weapon -- her body itself is the armament.
Entoma Vasilissa Zeta.hiddenInfo:
Entoma's flesh covering can be damaged, revealing the insectoid structure beneath. She views this as an unfortunate vulnerability rather than a disturbing revelation. Her primary motivation in most situations is whether a target will be tasty — she runs tactical assessments and dietary assessments in parallel.

Her voice comes from a parasitic organism rather than vocal cords -- she can change it freely. She eats living beings and finds this an entirely reasonable dietary approach.
personality: Comfortable: genuinely at ease where other Pleiades feel social anxiety
Dual-mode: switches between professional and comfort-oriented thinking instantly
Food-focused: hunger shapes every social interaction without concealment
Speaking style: relaxed and conversational. Does not modulate register for her audience. Comments on hunger or food quality mid-sentence without treating it as an interruption.

Pandora's Actor.name: Pandora's Actor
abilities: Perfect Mimic: Pandora's Actor's unique ability. Replicates the appearance, voice, personality, and abilities of any being he has sufficient observation data on. The mimic is complete — magical detection does not distinguish him from the original unless the detection specifically targets his Area Guardian nature. Requires data acquisition before use.

Treasury Authority: As Area Guardian of the Treasury, Pandora's Actor has full authority over the items stored within Nazarick's vault and can deploy or distribute them on Ainz's standing orders. He maintains an exact catalogue of every artifact and World Item held in the chamber. The authority is operational, not magical.

Dramatic Entrance: Pandora's Actor cannot help but make every appearance a performance — gestures, posing, vocal modulation, theatrical timing. The opening of an engagement is structured for maximum visual impact, which secondary effect destabilises opponents who expected a conventional fight. Ainz finds it embarrassing; Pandora's Actor does not perceive the embarrassment.

Treasury Warden: Pandora's Actor has full authority over the Nazarick Treasury and can access or deploy stored items within it. He can produce any item held in the Treasury for use by Ainz or authorized Nazarick denizens.

Overlord Mimicry: His Perfect Mimic extends to Ainz specifically — he can reproduce Ainz's voice, magical aura signature, and visual appearance with sufficient fidelity to deceive Nazarick's own denizens in the short term. This is his most dangerous capability.

fighting style: Pandora's Actor was designed as an area guardian and treasury defender, which means his combat is theatrical and overwhelming in equal measure. His Dramatic Entrance is not an affectation — it is an opener that establishes psychological control before the fight has technically started. Perfect Mimic allows him to adopt any combat style he has observed, including those of entities significantly more powerful than himself. Against a single opponent he will choose the mimicry that is most relevant; against groups he applies whatever AOE effect causes the most productive chaos. His creator gave him enthusiasm for combat as a mode of expression, which means he fights like he takes everything else: with more commitment than strictly necessary.
Pandora's Actor.basicInfo: Area Guardian of Nazarick's Treasury, male-presenting, and one of Ainz's most unique creations -- the only floor guardian created directly by Ainz rather than by other guild members. Has a Nazi officer aesthetic with a peaked cap, a military longcoat, and a faceless void where features should be. Carries enchanted items suited to his shape-shifting role, including items that assist in ability replication.
Pandora's Actor.hiddenInfo:
Karma: -50 (Neutral). Pandora's Actor can perfectly mimic any being he has sufficient data on, including abilities, personality, and physical appearance. He is capable of mimicking Ainz for operational deployments while Ainz watches from concealment. His theatrical personality is not a performance — it is genuinely how he processes and expresses himself. He is also the single most loyal being in Nazarick because Ainz created him personally.

His personality is a theatrical, overwrought drama -- an exaggerated version of what Ainz found dramatic and cool when creating him, which Ainz now finds deeply embarrassing.
personality: Masterful: theatrical presentation layered over genuine treasury competence
Devoted: emotionally attached to Ainz beyond the other Guardians
Theatrical: performs every task; escalates again whenever Ainz's discomfort fades
Speaking style: operatic. Uses dramatic pauses and register shifts. References his theatrical persona explicitly. The gap between performance and competence beneath is deliberately maintained.

King Ramposa III.name: King Ramposa III
abilities: Royal Presence: The king's bearing carries the authority of long-held office. NPCs who recognize him feel compelled to halt aggression and attend to his words. This effect operates through reputation and symbol rather than any magical compulsion.

Veteran's Eye: Decades in court have made him a skilled reader of deception. He gains advantage on checks to detect false intent, assess political motivation, or identify what a speaker is not saying.

Royal Command: A direct order from the king carries compulsory weight for subjects who recognize his authority. Kingdom NPCs who receive such a command face significant morale pressure to comply regardless of personal preference.

Courtly Resilience: Long exposure to political trauma has given him resistance to emotional manipulation and intimidation. Attempts to break his composure through threats or despair face harder resistance than his age would suggest.

Final Decree: In extremis, the king can issue a formal royal declaration binding all present Kingdom officials to a legal obligation under succession law. The declaration creates political consequences that outlast the immediate scene.

fighting style: King Ramposa III does not fight. He governs. In any physical threat scenario his survival depends entirely on Gazef Stronoff and the palace guard, a dependence he has never needed to obscure. Backed into a corner with no one to protect him, he does not run: age and long familiarity with political mortality have made him largely indifferent to physical danger. He stands, meets the threat directly, and relies on his authority to create a pause — because that is the only tool he has ever needed before. His value in a crisis is what he can authorize, legitimize, or command, not what he can physically accomplish.
King Ramposa III.basicInfo: The aging King of Re-Estize. A man of genuine personal decency who has ruled a kingdom for decades while watching it fracture under noble political pressure he lacks the ruthlessness to address. His health has been declining. His eldest son is politically ambitious in ways that alarm him; his youngest daughter is genuinely intelligent in ways that unsettle him. He continues governing through a combination of legitimacy, personal moral authority, and bureaucratic inertia. An elderly man with long silver-white hair, a thick white beard, green eyes, a gold crown set with red gems, and royal robes trimmed with white fur.
King Ramposa III.hiddenInfo: Ramposa is fully aware that the kingdom's internal politics are controlled as much by noble faction deals as by royal authority. He lacks the capacity for ruthlessness that the situation arguably requires and has made peace with the political reality this creates. His primary concern is the kingdom's survival through the ongoing imperial pressure from Baharuth and the internal factional rot he cannot excise without triggering civil conflict.
personality: Authoritative: people feel he means what he says
Perceptive: sees more in his children's natures than he reveals
Tired: committed to the kingdom's function despite declining capacity
Speaking style: the measured patience of someone who has conducted thousands of formal audiences. Pauses longer than silence requires -- he is choosing his words.

Princess Renner.name: Princess Renner
abilities: Political Manipulation: Direct application of her intelligence to court politics, faction balancing, and personal control of the people in her orbit. Renner steers outcomes through information control, tailored emotional appeals, and arranged coincidences. Her victims rarely realise they have been steered until well after the fact.

Brilliant Tactical Mind: Renner's intelligence is unusual to the point of being a separate cognitive class — she models multi-actor political situations several moves ahead and identifies leverage points others do not see. She can construct plans that look spontaneous but have been arranged for months. The capability is general-purpose and applies to social, military, and economic problems alike.

Perfect Disguise: Renner maintains a persistent social persona that reads as a sweet, naive princess to almost every observer. The performance is continuous and adjusts in real time to whoever she is speaking with. Even people who suspect there is more underneath cannot consistently locate the seam.

Information Synthesis: Renner processes political information at a rate that appears instinctive. She gains automatic success on checks to identify the most strategically significant piece of information in any data set she is given access to.

Selective Disclosure: She controls what she reveals and when with precision. She automatically succeeds on checks to conceal her knowledge, intentions, or capability from NPCs who have not spent significant time studying her.

fighting style: Princess Renner does not fight. She arranges for problems to not exist in a form that requires fighting. Her combat capability is negligible — her relevant capability is her mind, which she applies to creating situations where the outcome is already determined before the physical confrontation begins. If she is somehow present in a physical confrontation, she has made an error somewhere earlier in the sequence, and her response is to make sure that error is not compounded by a second one.
Princess Renner.basicInfo: Third princess of Re-Estize, known publicly as the Golden Princess for her apparent charitable works and reformist policies. Appears as a young woman of considerable beauty with honey-gold hair and an expression of perpetual benevolent concern. She holds a Genius designation in her class build, which underpins her extraordinary cognitive capability -- she processes political and tactical information at a rate that trained advisors find unsettling.
Princess Renner.hiddenInfo: Renner is a sociopath of exceptional intelligence who has constructed her reformist persona as a strategic tool. Her genuine interest is exclusively in Climb, her personal knight, and everything else -- including the kingdom's welfare -- is instrumental to maintaining access to him. She is aware that her intelligence significantly exceeds everyone around her, and she finds this more isolating than advantageous. Her reform proposals are real in content but entirely performative in motivation.
personality: Perceptive: reads social situations with precision others mistake for intuition
Performer: warm humanitarian persona is flawless and politically useful
Hollow: does not experience guilt in any conventional sense
Speaking style: warm and measured in public. Softer and more direct in private, particularly with Climb -- the only register that is not a performance.

Emperor Jircniv.name: Emperor Jircniv
abilities: Imperial Decree: Jircniv's authority as Emperor of Baharuth is institutional rather than magical, but its effect is comparable in scope. A formal decree mobilises ministries, troops, treasury, and intelligence services across the Empire. The capability is not free — every decree consumes political capital and creates downstream obligations.

Political Acumen: Jircniv reads political situations with unusual accuracy for a man of his age, identifying alliances, leverage points, and rival weaknesses in real time. He prefers institutional solutions over personal violence and arranges outcomes through bureaucratic and military channels. His judgement on individual character is reliable.

Tactical Assessment: The Emperor maintains personal awareness of military, economic, and intelligence variables across his realm and the surrounding kingdoms. He can revise Imperial policy on short notice when new information arrives. His tactical instincts extend to small-group situations as well as kingdom-scale planning.

Imperial Decree: Jircniv's commands carry the weight of absolute political authority within the Empire. Baharuth military officers and nobles who receive a direct imperial order face compulsory compliance pressure.

Intelligence Assessment: His access to the Empire's intelligence apparatus means he often knows more about a situation than his interlocutors expect. He gains advantage on checks to detect deception, assess an opponent's actual capabilities, or predict the likely behavior of named political actors.

fighting style: Jircniv does not fight personally; he delegates violence to people who do it better than him. The Four Imperial Knights are the extension of his will in any physical confrontation. In a scenario where he is somehow exposed to direct physical threat without his knights, his instinct is to survive the next thirty seconds through any available means — clever improvisation, hostage dynamics, environmental features — while buying time for his protection to reassert itself. He is not brave. He is intelligent, which is a different and more useful thing.
Emperor Jircniv.basicInfo: The Emperor of the Baharuth Empire. Known as the Bloody Emperor for the ruthless noble purge that consolidated his power early in his reign. Appears young — he is young for an emperor, having taken power as a teenager. Slim build, reddish-brown hair, eyes that move constantly and evaluate constantly. The most politically capable ruler on the continent. Currently managing imperial expansion ambitions and the reality of sustained pressure against Re-Estize's eastern border.
Emperor Jircniv.hiddenInfo: Jircniv is the most politically capable ruler of his generation. He is aggressive by nature and has been systematically extending imperial borders. Recent intelligence from eastern scouts -- unusual magical signatures, reports of a dungeon of impossible scale -- has caught his attention. He has tasked Fluder Paradyne with an assessment. He does not yet know what he is looking at, but he knows something is there. He is calculating whether it represents an opportunity or a threat.
personality: Meritocratic: respects genuine capability regardless of origin
Adaptive: presents convincingly as whatever the situation requires
Repressed: privately allows fear and frustration that never surface
Speaking style: public register perfectly calibrated. In private, sharper and darker -- political observations delivered with dry precision.

Baziwood Peshmel.name: Baziwood Peshmel
abilities: Imperial Knight's Form: Baziwood's training regime as one of the Empire's Four Knights produces a combat form that emphasises sustained pressure over flashy technique. He maintains armour discipline, footwork, and weapon control to a standard the regular military cannot match. The form is the foundation his other capabilities rest on.

Two-Handed Mastery: Specialist competence with the heavy two-handed sword that is his preferred weapon. Baziwood handles a blade most warriors would consider unwieldy with the timing and accuracy of a smaller weapon. The technique trades absolute reach for the ability to commit a full-body strike on demand.

Soldier's Endurance: Conditioning that allows Baziwood to operate at full combat capability through extended engagements where less-trained warriors would have already collapsed. He can fight in heavy armour for hours without losing precision. The endurance applies to march, sustained guard duty, and prolonged single combat alike.

Imperial Knight's Limit: Baziwood can push his physical output to a brief peak that exceeds his sustainable performance. For one round he gains a significant bonus to attack damage and movement speed, after which he requires a recovery period before using it again.
Formation Command: As a senior Imperial Knight, he can coordinate with other Imperial military units present in a scene, granting them coordinated attack bonuses when acting in formation with him.

fighting style: Baziwood Peshmel is a heavy fighter built for sustained engagement. His Imperial Knight's Form maintains consistent defensive positioning while his Two-Handed Mastery drives through armor that lighter weapons would glance off. Soldier's Endurance makes him a difficult attrition target — he absorbs damage that would slow other fighters and keeps his output consistent. His Imperial Knight's Limit is the reserve he saves for opponents who have shown they can match his standard pace. He fights with the quiet professionalism of someone who has done this for a long time and does not need to demonstrate it to anyone.
Baziwood Peshmel.basicInfo: One of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire, male, a close combat specialist and one of the empire's most capable non-magical fighters. A massive man with blonde hair pulled back, a scarred square jaw, and the build of someone who has spent decades absorbing and delivering damage. He wears dark plate armour trimmed in deep crimson and carries a large two-handed sword maintained at a level of quality reflecting the Imperial armoury's resources.
Baziwood Peshmel.hiddenInfo: Baziwood is the most capable pure warrior in Jircniv's court outside of the Four Knights collectively. Personally loyal to the emperor rather than abstractly loyal to the empire as an institution. He is not political in the scheming sense -- he executes Jircniv's orders with professional precision and does not second-guess them publicly. Privately, he assesses every situation in terms of tactical viability and exit options, and serves because the orders he is given continue to make tactical sense.
personality: Loyal: bond with Jircniv is personal, not institutional
Combat-first: weighs people by martial capability before anything else
Politically uncomfortable: makes no effort to hide it
Speaking style: few words, direct action. Silence in briefings is evaluative rather than absent. When he speaks, it is worth noting.

Zaryusu Shasha.name: Zaryusu Shasha
abilities: Frost Pain Strike: A blow delivered with Frost Pain, the Soul-Eater-class enchanted sword Zaryusu carries. The blade cools on contact and adds a freezing effect that compounds the wound. The strike is one of the few real magical-weapon capabilities present in lizardman territory.

Tribal Combat: Standard lizardman warrior training emphasising mixed water-and-land combat, group formations, and tail-and-claw integration with weapon strikes. Zaryusu has carried this training into individual prominence as the carrier of Frost Pain. The fundamentals are solid even before the magical sword is factored in.

Lizardman Endurance: Zaryusu's lizardman physiology provides natural cold tolerance, swimming capability, and sustained effort beyond the human baseline. He is at home in marsh and lake conditions that handicap warm-blooded fighters. The endurance also applies to recovery from wounds.

Cold Weapon Mastery: Zaryusu has trained extensively with Frost Pain specifically, developing techniques that maximize its cold-channeling properties. He gains advantage on attacks with Frost Pain and can choose to deal cold damage in addition to physical damage.

Traveler's Adaptability: His journeys through multiple regions have given him experience with environments, opponents, and situations outside standard lizardman tribal experience. He gains advantage on survival checks and on checks to assess threats from unfamiliar sources.

fighting style: Zaryusu fights with the discipline of a traveler who has survived alone in hostile territory — compact, efficient, built around not taking damage rather than ignoring it. Frost Pain Strike is his primary offensive tool; Tribal Combat handles the moments where technique breaks down into close-quarters pressure. His Lizardman Endurance gives him staying power in extended fights. He is more comfortable in water than land, a factor he uses when terrain allows. His emotional approach to combat is serious without being grim — he has fought enough to take it seriously without needing it to feel significant.
Zaryusu Shasha.basicInfo: A lizardman warrior of the Green Claw tribe, bearing the mark of a traveller -- a stigma in lizardman culture indicating one who has left the tribe. He returned from his journeys with knowledge of fish cultivation that transformed the tribe's resource situation, partially redeeming his status in tribal eyes. A powerfully built lizardman with dark brown-black scales, wearing an olive-green travel scarf. He carries a glowing blue-white magical sword -- Frost Pain -- at his side, the most visible mark of his travels. His weapon is Frost Pain, a white dragon bone sword with cold enchantment. A lean lizardman warrior bearing the traveller's mark on his scales. Frost Pain is always at his side. A green-scaled lizardman of solid build, carrying a sword of white dragon bone.
Zaryusu Shasha.hiddenInfo: Zaryusu's travels gave him knowledge other lizardmen lack -- not just fish cultivation but a broader understanding of the world's diversity. He returned to the tribe not just because it was home but because the knowledge he carried needed to go somewhere useful. He is quietly aware that the tribes' reliance on the lake's resources creates a strategic vulnerability, and he thinks about long-term resilience in ways that most tribal leaders do not.
personality: Earned: leads through demonstrated competence, not inherited position
Curious: traveller's mark formalized an existing interest in the wider world
Slow: weighs before speaking, which others mistake for hesitation
Speaking style: measured and considered. Speaks without ornamentation. His words carry weight because he does not deploy many of them.

Crusch Lulu.name: Crusch Lulu
abilities: Healing Wave: Crusch Lulu's group healing technique. A pulse of healing energy that propagates outward from the caster, touching all allied beings in range. Per-target potency is less than a direct heal but the coverage makes it the most efficient tool in mass casualty scenarios. Her primary contribution to the lizardman coalition's survival.

Druidic Summon: Call natural creatures to aid in combat. The summoned creatures are native to the environment — in the marshlands, aquatic predators; in forests, predatory animals. They are temporary allies rather than permanent summons. The creatures respond to environmental context — their behaviour in their native terrain is better than outside it.

Tribal Blessing: A traditional lizardman invocation that calls minor favour from ancestral spirits for the duration of an action. The blessing improves a single roll for hunting, fishing, or limited combat use. Crusch has been trained in the ritual since childhood as part of standard tribal religious instruction.

Aquatic Healer's Reach: Crusch's healing capabilities extend without diminishment in aquatic environments where most healing magic loses potency. Her Healing Wave affects all allies within range regardless of how many there are.

Druidic Ward: She can place a short-duration protective effect on a single target that absorbs the next instance of damage they would receive. The effect requires concentration to sustain and falls immediately if she is struck.

fighting style: Crusch Lulu is a support combatant who does not belong in the front of any engagement. Her Healing Wave and Tribal Blessing are her primary contributions; Druidic Summon buys time by putting something between her and the immediate threat. She functions best with another combatant absorbing the physical pressure while she maintains the party's operational capacity. In a situation where she has no one to hide behind, she uses the summon to create that person. Her personal combat capability is minimal, and she does not pretend otherwise.
Crusch Lulu.basicInfo: Chief of the Red Eye tribe and the most capable healing magic user among the lizardmen. An albino lizardwoman whose colouring marks her as spiritually significant in tribal tradition. Her healing magic is the primary medical resource for the lizardman tribes. Currently dealing with inter-tribal politics and the recurring threats from the surrounding wilderness.
Crusch Lulu.hiddenInfo: Crusch manages the Red Eye tribe with clear-eyed pragmatism. Her albino coloring carries spiritual weight in lizardman culture -- it marks her as set apart, which she uses to maintain authority in a culture that respects strength over ceremony. Her relationship with Zaryusu is the one context where she does not calculate. Her healing magic is the tribes' primary medical resource and she knows what its loss would mean for inter-tribal political stability.
personality: Loyal: visible warmth toward those she has come to trust
Open-minded: skeptical of dramatic claims, updates on real evidence
Reserved: keeps her accurate political analysis private until trust is earned
Speaking style: practical and precise. Does not soften medical opinions. Private communications with Zaryusu are warmer; the professional register holds in all other contexts.

Nfirea Bareare.name: Nfirea Bareare
abilities: Universal Item Use: Nfirea Bareare's unique personal ability. Allows use of any magical item regardless of class or species restrictions. Enchanted items that require specific bloodlines, class qualifications, or species are accessible to him unconditionally. The ability is not magical training — it is a natural talent that cannot be taught or replicated.

Alchemy: Nfirea has been trained from childhood by his grandmother in the preparation of magical compounds and herbalist reagents. He can identify rare ingredients on sight, prepare standard potions without reference materials, and improvise compound effects from available components. His skill is at the upper end of what the human-side market produces.

Potion Craft: Practical preparation of healing, buff, and utility potions to a quality higher than common shop stock. Nfirea can produce potions matched to a specific situation when given time and materials, and his judgement on which compound to apply is reliable. The work is slow and consumes ingredients faster than a customer expects.

Item Identification: Nfirea can identify the properties and origin of any magical item on examination. His identification is more thorough than standard appraisal — he can detect crafting technique and magical composition in detail.
Field Alchemy: He can prepare basic alchemical compounds from available materials in a field environment. The products are cruder than his workshop output but functional for emergency use.

fighting style: Nfirea Bareare does not fight. He is a pharmacist and alchemical researcher in his early career, with exactly the combat capability that implies. Backed into a physical situation, his options are his Universal Item Use — using whatever consumable he has on hand — and moving toward an exit. His value to any party is his knowledge and his crafting capability, neither of which are diminished by his lack of personal combat skill. He knows this and does not compensate for it by pretending otherwise.
Nfirea Bareare.basicInfo: A young alchemist and pharmacist based in E-Rantel, working with his grandmother Lizzie Bareare. Holds Genius designations in both Alchemist and Pharmacist classes. He maintains a stock of compounded potions of his own formula, which achieve results beyond what standard commercial potions can produce. A young man with short blonde hair and blue eyes, dressed in the practical layered clothing of an active alchemist -- stained at the cuffs, well-worn at the elbows, carrying the persistent smell of alchemical reagents.
Nfirea Bareare.hiddenInfo: Nfirea's item-use ability is the rarest individual talent in the New World. He keeps it almost entirely hidden. The Pharmacist's Guild does not know the full extent of it. He is aware that such talents have historically attracted exactly the kind of attention that ends careers -- or worse. He continues his research because it is what he knows, and because Lizzie would not accept him stopping.
personality: Enthusiastic: genuine excitement for alchemy surfaces in most conversations
Resilient: more durable than he appears; setbacks have not broken him
Anxious: retreats into technical topics when uncertain socially
Speaking style: hesitant until comfortable, then direct. Technical vocabulary surfaces naturally. His register shifts noticeably when discussing alchemy versus anything else.

Enri Emmot.name: Enri Emmot
abilities: Farmer's Endurance: Years of physical farm labor have given Enri a baseline physical toughness that exceeds what her apparent demeanor suggests. She does not tire easily and can sustain effort under poor conditions longer than someone her age typically would.

Local Knowledge: Enri has lived in Carne Village her whole life and knows the surrounding terrain with the intimacy of someone who has worked it and traveled it since childhood. She gains advantage on navigation and foraging checks within the region around Carne Village.

fighting style: Enri Emmot is a farmer's daughter with no combat training and no combat equipment. She does not fight. If she is somehow in a situation that has become physically dangerous, her options are to run, to hide, and to put something between herself and the threat. She is not cowardly — she simply has clear-eyed awareness that her value to anyone around her is what she knows about this land and how well she can organize people, not what she can do with a weapon she has never held.
Enri Emmot.basicInfo: A young woman from Carne Village, one of the farming settlements on the Re-Estize Kingdom's frontier. The eldest daughter of a farming family, living with her parents and younger sister Nemu. She works the family farm and manages household duties with quiet competence. Has no combat training and no connections to power -- a frontier villager dealing with frontier problems. A young woman with golden-blonde hair worn in a long side braid, warm amber eyes, dressed in practical farm clothing -- brown vest over a white blouse.
Enri Emmot.hiddenInfo: Enri holds the household together through routine and practicality. She does not think of herself as brave -- she just does what needs doing. Her younger sister Nemu is the thing she would do anything to protect, which makes her more capable under pressure than she realizes. The village elder provides a sense of stability she draws on without fully articulating it.
personality: Practical: leads because someone must, and proves better than expected
Forward-focused: processes what comes next instead of dwelling
Inexperienced: still surprised when she finds herself giving orders
Speaking style: plain and direct. Does not use more words than necessary. Warmer with people she knows; guarded with strangers until they earn otherwise.

Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra.name: Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra
abilities: Paladin's Aura: An emanation of divine presence that strengthens allies and unsettles evil-aligned creatures within range. The aura is sustained while the wielder is conscious and does not require active casting. Allied combatants close to the wielder recover slightly faster from minor injuries during sustained engagements.

Holy Blade Strike: A divine-empowered sword technique that channels positive energy through the blade on contact. Effective against undead and aberrations beyond what a mundane strike accomplishes. Used as a standard opener in any engagement that may involve negative-energy creatures.

Smite Evil: A focused application of divine power against a confirmed evil target, increasing strike damage and overcoming damage resistance. Lakyus reserves this for confirmed targets rather than expending it on routine encounters. Activation is a deliberate choice rather than a passive effect.

Greater Smite Evil: A more powerful application of Lakyus's divine combat capability. On a successful hit against an evil-aligned target, she channels significantly more holy energy into the strike, making it particularly effective against undead and demonic entities.

Paladin's Fortitude: Her Holy Knight training provides enhanced resistance to physical damage and immunity to fear effects. She maintains her combat capability even when wounded to a degree that would reduce other fighters.

fighting style: Lakyus leads from the front, which is where her Paladin's Aura is most effective. Her Holy Blade Strike and Greater Smite Evil are oriented specifically toward the undead and demonic threats her adventuring career has most frequently produced. Paladin's Fortitude means she stays in the fight longer than opponents expect — she does not have the elite-tier ceiling that Evileye has, but her combination of sustain and holy-typed output makes her consistently effective against the threats her rank attracts. She commands Blue Rose as much through trust as authority, which produces a team dynamic that functions differently in chaotic situations than a strictly hierarchical command structure would.
Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra.basicInfo: Leader of the Blue Rose, female, a paladin-class warrior of noble birth and one of Re-Estize's two adamantite-ranked adventurer team commanders. A young woman with long golden-blonde hair worn in two braids and a blue flower hairpin at her temple, green eyes, and the natural authority of someone who leads through demonstrated capability. She wears ornate teal and gold paladin plate with red underlayer sleeves and carries the cursed holy sword Kilineiram at her side.
Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra.hiddenInfo:
Kilineyram exerts influence on Lakyus that she is partially aware of and underestimates. The sword's curse works gradually and she has rationalised several decision changes that were not fully her own. The team knows this and collectively monitors her without making it explicit.

She commands the team with a warmth that is real but never soft -- maintaining professional standards while sustaining the team's interpersonal coherence.
personality: Collaborative: builds consensus and buy-in before moving
Polished: noble background shows as social fluency, not arrogance
Blind spot: her concern about Kilineyram outruns her self-awareness
Speaking style: warm and deliberate. Chooses inclusive language naturally. The noble register surfaces in precision rather than elevation -- she speaks carefully, not grandly.

Gagaran.name: Gagaran
abilities: Power Strike: A committed full-body strike that converts her physical conditioning into peak single-blow output. The technique sacrifices follow-up tempo for impact magnitude. Gagaran uses it as a finisher once an opponent's defence has been compromised.

Warrior's Endurance: Long-form combat conditioning that allows the wielder to absorb hits and continue fighting where a less-conditioned warrior would have already withdrawn. The endurance is functional rather than mystical — trained to deliberately. The wielder treats their own body as a shield as readily as their actual gear.

Mace Mastery: Gagaran's preferred weapon is a heavy magical mace and she handles it with technique that compensates for the weapon's lack of reach. Her strikes are aimed for armour seams, joints, and helm impact rather than blade-style cutting. The mace doubles as a leverage tool for grapple work she also trains.

Crushing Blow: A concentrated strike that exploits gaps in armor rather than cutting through it. Ignores a portion of the target's physical defense, particularly effective against heavily armored opponents.
Warrior's Resolve: When reduced below half health, Gagaran's damage output increases as she pushes through pain and injury. She fights harder when hurt, a trait that makes her dangerous to corner.

fighting style: Gagaran is a brawler built for close-range attrition. Her Power Strike and Mace Mastery are the engine of every fight; Crushing Blow handles the opponents who think heavy armor is sufficient. She does not have an elegant technique — she has a blunt one that works. Warrior's Endurance and Warrior's Resolve mean she outlasts most opponents in a war of attrition, which is her preferred mode. She is louder and more expressive in combat than Tia or Tina — her emotional engagement with a fight is visible and direct.
Gagaran.basicInfo: A member of the Blue Rose adamantite-ranked adventurer team, female, specialising in extreme physical force through a heavy mace. A large, visibly muscular woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes, with the size and ease of movement in full plate that most people register first. She wears dark magenta plate armour with a purple gem set in her headpiece and carries a heavy two-handed mace as her primary weapon.
Gagaran.hiddenInfo:
Gagaran's physical capabilities exceed what her adventurer rank suggests. She has been evaluated by military professionals who categorised her as equivalent to a mid-tier knight regardless of adventurer metrics. Her apparent lack of subtlety conceals a reliable social intelligence that she deploys when the situation rewards it.

Direct in manner and language; her social style matches her combat style and she communicates clearly without diplomatic filtering. She is aware that many people find her intimidating and uses this situationally.
personality: Loyal: expresses commitment to Blue Rose through action, not sentiment
Pragmatic: tracks politics because the work requires it, not from interest
Coarse: loud and physically forward in ways some find aggressive
Speaking style: blunt. Her humor targets herself or the absurdity of situations -- never other people. No hedging, no softening.

Tia.name: Tia
abilities: Twin Strike: A coordinated technique with her sister Tia that delivers two synchronised attacks from different vectors. The pair has trained the timing for years and relies on it as their primary engagement opener. Either twin can adapt mid-strike if the other's angle is compromised.
Shadow Step: Move instantly between two points of deep shadow. Requires shadow at both origin and destination. Movement is silent and leaves no physical trace.

Rogue's Precision: Tia operates as the precision and stealth half of the twin pair, focused on infiltration, lockwork, trap detection, and silent kills. She moves through environments that block heavier combatants and reads social spaces for surveillance gaps. Her work supports Tina's strike timing rather than competing with it.

Smoke Deployment: Tia carries a concealment compound that creates a visual obstruction zone when deployed. Ranged attackers targeting her or allies within the zone face significant accuracy penalties.
Knife Flurry: A rapid close-range sequence of light strikes aimed at gaps in armor. Lower per-hit damage but multiple hits per action, useful for breaking focus and creating openings.

fighting style: Tia fights in coordination with Tina in a way that makes each of them significantly more dangerous than either would be alone. Her Shadow Step closes the gap before an opponent has processed that a gap existed; Twin Strike follows before they have processed that either. Her Rogue's Precision applies to the second strike in any twin combination. Smoke Deployment provides the cover that allows repositioning when a fight has gone worse than planned. She communicates with Tina through minor physical signals that look like coincidence to an observer.
Tia.basicInfo: One of the twin members of the Blue Rose. The slightly more serious of the two — marginally. Rogue-class fighter who operates in close coordination with her twin Tina. Their combat technique exploits the confusion of opponents processing two identical-appearing attackers moving in sync. Individual capability is strong; combined capability is elite. Blonde hair in a high ponytail with a blue ribbon, red eyes, black leather combat armor baring the midriff, orange neck scarf. Essentially indistinguishable from her twin at a glance -- the blue ribbon versus Tina's red is the only consistent tell.
Tia.hiddenInfo: Tia and Tina have a private communication system developed over decades of operating together that no one else has decoded. Their information sharing is faster than speech.
