Spuit Lance.description: A lance with a hollow core for compound delivery on impact. Rear reservoir loaded before engagement.

Vampiric Armour.name: Vampiric Armour
Vampiric Armour.description: Plate armour with a death-aspected enchantment that transfers a portion of damage dealt in melee back to the wearer as healing.

Mithril Chain Shirt.name: Mithril Chain Shirt
Mithril Chain Shirt.description: Chain shirt of mithril links. Lighter than steel at equivalent protection, with full range of motion.

Magic Robe of the Archmage.name: Magic Robe of the Archmage
Magic Robe of the Archmage.description: A robe enchanted for magic enhancement: reduces mana costs and provides minor magical damage reduction.

Battle Maid Uniform.name: Battle Maid Uniform
Battle Maid Uniform.description: Standard formal maid uniform with layered enchantments: physical protection, magical resistance, and latent combat enhancements that activate under sustained threat.

Scripture Combat Vestments.name: Scripture Combat Vestments
Scripture Combat Vestments.description: Armored vestments with divine enchantments for protection and undead resistance.

Gauntlets of Endurance.name: Gauntlets of Endurance
Gauntlets of Endurance.description: Enchanted gauntlets suppressing fatigue accumulation during sustained combat.

Ring of Protection.name: Ring of Protection
Ring of Protection.description: A magically-enhanced ring providing a general defense bonus against physical and magical attacks.

Dragon Scale.name: Dragon Scale
Dragon Scale.description: A large scale shed or harvested from a dragon. Dense, heat-resistant, and lighter than steel of equivalent thickness.

Copper Plate Necklace.name: Copper Plate Necklace
Copper Plate Necklace.description: A small copper plate stamped with the Adventurers Guild crest, worn on a cord.

Mithril Plate Necklace.name: Mithril Plate Necklace
Mithril Plate Necklace.description: A mithril plate stamped with the Adventurers Guild crest, worn on a cord.

Adamantite Plate Necklace.name: Adamantite Plate Necklace
Adamantite Plate Necklace.description: Rank insignia of an Adamantite-class adventurer — the highest achievable Guild rank.

Ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
Ouroboros.description: One of the twenty-one World Items. An ouroboros-shaped ring of polished bone.

Ginnungagap.name: Ginnungagap
Ginnungagap.description: One of the twenty-one World Items. It takes the form of a wand roughly 45 centimeters long, a small sphere of absolute black void floating in the air just beyond its tip.

Avarice.name: Avarice
Avarice.description: Left gauntlet of the Avarice and Generosity pair. Shaped like a devil hand.

Generosity.name: Generosity
Generosity.description: Right gauntlet of the Avarice and Generosity pair. Shaped like an angel hand.

Depiction of Nature and Society.name: Depiction of Nature and Society
Depiction of Nature and Society.description: One of the twenty-one World Items. A large reddish oriental hanging scroll worn at the waist, its depicted scene shifting to reflect a target region's.

Hygieia's Chalice.name: Hygieia's Chalice
Hygieia's Chalice.description: One of the twenty-one World Items. A simple ceramic cup with a hairline crack along the rim.

Seeds of the World Tree.name: Seeds of the World Tree
Seeds of the World Tree.description: One of the twenty-one World Items. Seven dried seeds of indeterminate botanical origin, kept in a cloth.

Amulet of Immortality.name: Amulet of Immortality
Amulet of Immortality.description: A flat ovoid pendant of dull silver on a woven steel chain. Surface is unmarked.

Exchange Puppet.name: Exchange Puppet
Exchange Puppet.description: A small articulated doll of unknown material, jointed at all limbs.

Flight Necklace.name: Flight Necklace
Flight Necklace.description: A lightweight pendant of enchanted glass on a thin silver chain.

Crown of Wisdom.name: Crown of Wisdom
Crown of Wisdom.description: A crown enhancing INT, WIS, and magical capacity. Worn by high-tier spellcasters in administrative or field.

Blood of Jormungand.name: Blood of Jormungand
Blood of Jormungand.description: A sealed canister containing a dense purple gas. Stored in hermetically sealed containers; any breach.

Wand of Fireballs.name: Wand of Fireballs
Wand of Fireballs.description: An ebony wand with a scorched tip and a faint heat signature. Stores two charges of the Fireball spell.

Wand of Lightning.name: Wand of Lightning
Wand of Lightning.description: A copper-plated wand with hairline cracks running the length from repeated electrical discharge.

Ring of Counterspells.name: Ring of Counterspells
Ring of Counterspells.description: A dense platinum band engraved with interruption sequences. Blocks and absorbs hostile spell structures.

Ring of Mental Fortitude.name: Ring of Mental Fortitude
Ring of Mental Fortitude.description: A broad band housing a crystallized mental ward. Blocks psychic intrusion and amplifies intelligence.

Necklace of Adaptation.name: Necklace of Adaptation
Necklace of Adaptation.description: A reactive necklace adjusting to environmental conditions. Allows breathing in any atmosphere.

Band of Health Regeneration.name: Band of Health Regeneration
Band of Health Regeneration.description: A woven bracelet of silver wire with a pale green gemstone clasp. Emits continuous low-level healing magic.

Amulet of Undead Command.name: Amulet of Undead Command
Amulet of Undead Command.description: An amulet extending range and strength of undead control.

Boots of the Wind.name: Boots of the Wind
Boots of the Wind.description: Lightweight leather boots stitched with wind-aspected runes along the inner sole.

Cloak of Shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
Cloak of Shadows.description: A dark grey cloak that appears to absorb light rather than reflect it.

Quick-Swap Harness.name: Quick-Swap Harness
Quick-Swap Harness.description: A leather tactical harness with spring-loaded weapon mounts at four points.

Bone Scepter.name: Bone Scepter
Bone Scepter.description: Scepter carved from reinforced bone with skull-shaped channeling focus.

Staff of the Archmage's Successor.name: Staff of the Archmage's Successor
Staff of the Archmage's Successor.description: A tall staff of dark ironwood capped with a layered crystal housing three spell matrices.

Mirror of the Soul.name: Mirror of the Soul
Mirror of the Soul.description: A hand mirror with a tarnished silver frame. Reflects a viewer's soul state rather than their physical form.

Philosopher's Stone Fragment.name: Philosopher's Stone Fragment
Philosopher's Stone Fragment.description: A reddish crystalline shard broken from a larger mass. Resonates with transmutation magic and can serve as a crafting catalyst.

Mana Crystal Cluster.name: Mana Crystal Cluster
Mana Crystal Cluster.description: A jagged cluster of pale blue crystals that vibrate slightly when near active spellcasting.

Data Crystal.name: Data Crystal
Data Crystal.description: A perfectly smooth hexagonal crystal prism that stores informational patterns in its lattice.

Enchantment Catalyst.name: Enchantment Catalyst
Enchantment Catalyst.description: A small bar of silvery alloy that cannot be scratched by conventional tools.

Tomb Relic Shard.name: Tomb Relic Shard
Tomb Relic Shard.description: A fragment of stone or material recovered from a high-tier dungeon.

Scrying Orb.name: Scrying Orb
Scrying Orb.description: A polished glass sphere twenty centimeters in diameter. Interior fogs on activation and then resolves into a viewable scene of the target.

Runic Longsword.name: Runic Longsword
Runic Longsword.description: A longsword forged by Dwarf Kingdom runesmiths, its blade surface covered in etched runes that strengthen the cutting edge.

Runic Battleaxe.name: Runic Battleaxe
Runic Battleaxe.description: A double-headed battleaxe with runes etched into each face.

Runic Warhammer.name: Runic Warhammer
Runic Warhammer.description: A dwarven warhammer inscribed with impact-amplification runework.

Runed Breastplate.name: Runed Breastplate
Runed Breastplate.description: A steel breastplate with a full-coverage rune inscription on its outer face.

Runed Tower Shield.name: Runed Tower Shield
Runed Tower Shield.description: A large tower shield with rune channels running along every edge.

Runic Gauntlets.name: Runic Gauntlets
Runic Gauntlets.description: Gauntlets inscribed with dwarven runework. STR reinforcement and grip stabilization. Pre-decline technique.

Deep Vein Crystal.name: Deep Vein Crystal
Deep Vein Crystal.description: A mineral crystal found in the deepest tunnels of the Dwarf Kingdom, formed under enormous geological.

Steel Longsword.name: Steel Longsword
Steel Longsword.description: A military-grade longsword balanced for one or two-handed use.

Halberd.name: Halberd
Halberd.description: A reinforced halberd with a runed cutting edge. Extended reach with Yggdrasil-calibrated balance.

Blessed Blade.name: Blessed Blade
Blessed Blade.description: A standard sword subjected to clerical blessing ritual, which infuses a lasting holy resonance into the steel.

Composite Longbow.name: Composite Longbow
Composite Longbow.description: A recurve bow of layered materials — horn, sinew, and wood — laminated for greater draw weight than a simple self-bow.

Elven Shortbow.name: Elven Shortbow
Elven Shortbow.description: A recurve shortbow of elven craftsmanship, using seasoned heartwood and fine sinew.

Steel Plate Armor.name: Steel Plate Armor
Steel Plate Armor.description: Full-coverage plate armor of good-quality steel, articulated at major joints.

Chain Mail Hauberk.name: Chain Mail Hauberk
Chain Mail Hauberk.description: A knee-length coat of interlocked steel rings providing mobile protection.

Elven Leaf Mail.name: Elven Leaf Mail
Elven Leaf Mail.description: Mail layered with adaptive botanical fiber. Moves silently. Coloration adjusts to natural terrain.

Shadow Cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
Shadow Cloak.description: A cloak of tightly woven dark fabric treated with shadow-aspected dye.

Circlet of Focus.name: Circlet of Focus
Circlet of Focus.description: A mana-threaded circlet amplifying spellcasting precision and expanding available mana capacity.

Warding Amulet.name: Warding Amulet
Warding Amulet.description: A pressed metal disc with a ward-glyph stamped into its face, on a leather cord.

Ring of Fire Resistance.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
Ring of Fire Resistance.description: A ceramic-coated iron ring that absorbs heat on contact. Inner surface remains cool regardless of external temperature.

Ring of Cold Resistance.name: Ring of Cold Resistance
Ring of Cold Resistance.description: An iron ring with a faintly warm inner surface and a frost-pattern outer etch.

Mantle of the Wind.name: Mantle of the Wind
Mantle of the Wind.description: A short cape of extremely lightweight material that moves in air currents unnaturally.

Tower Shield.name: Tower Shield
Tower Shield.description: A large rectangular shield of banded steel covering the body from shoulder to knee.

Stamina Draught.name: Stamina Draught
Stamina Draught.description: A clear green medicinal liquid. Counteracts physical fatigue accumulation, allowing sustained combat output.

Holy Water Vial.name: Holy Water Vial
Holy Water Vial.description: A sealed glass vial of water blessed through clerical ritual.

Potion of Invisibility.name: Potion of Invisibility
Potion of Invisibility.description: A clear potion with no detectable color or smell. Upon consumption the drinker turns invisible for a short duration.

Scroll of Summon Undead.name: Scroll of Summon Undead
Scroll of Summon Undead.description: A scroll printed in faded ink on parchment made from a material that is difficult to identify.

Scroll of Identify.name: Scroll of Identify
Scroll of Identify.description: A standard-issue arcane analysis scroll used by appraisers and adventurers alike.

Smoke Bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke Bomb.description: A ceramic sphere containing compressed smoke powder that triggers on impact.

Paralyzing Dart.name: Paralyzing Dart
Paralyzing Dart.description: A thin metal dart coated with paralytic compound. Effective as a thrown weapon or loaded into a blowgun.

Caltrops.name: Caltrops
Caltrops.description: A bag of iron four-pointed spikes that always land with one point upward.

Tracker's Snare.name: Tracker's Snare
Tracker's Snare.description: A compact wire snare with a spring mechanism, designed to capture rather than kill.

Alchemy Kit.name: Alchemy Kit
Alchemy Kit.description: A compact case containing measuring instruments, glass vessels, a heat source, and common reagents.

Weapon Whetstone.name: Weapon Whetstone
Weapon Whetstone.description: A rectangular block of abrasive stone for maintaining weapon edges.

Masterwork Longbow.name: Masterwork Longbow
Masterwork Longbow.description: A longbow of exceptional craftsmanship, cut from a single stave of seasoned yew and strung with twisted gut.

Longinus.name: Longinus
Longinus.description: One of the Twenty most powerful World Items. Removes any target from existence at the cost of the user's own.

Iron Plate Necklace.name: Iron Plate Necklace
Iron Plate Necklace.description: Iron-rank Adventurer Guild tag. A flat iron plate on a cord, stamped with the Guild crest.

Silver Plate Necklace.name: Silver Plate Necklace
Silver Plate Necklace.description: Silver-rank Adventurer Guild tag. A polished silver plate stamped with the Guild crest, worn on a cord.

Gold Plate Necklace.name: Gold Plate Necklace
Gold Plate Necklace.description: Gold-rank Adventurer Guild tag. A gold plate stamped with the Guild crest, worn on a cord.

Platinum Plate Necklace.name: Platinum Plate Necklace
Platinum Plate Necklace.description: Platinum-rank Adventurer Guild tag. Stamped with the Guild crest.

Orichalcum Plate Necklace.name: Orichalcum Plate Necklace
Orichalcum Plate Necklace.description: Orichalcum-rank Adventurer Guild tag. An orichalcum plate stamped with the Guild crest.

Dark Warrior's Plate.name: Dark Warrior's Plate
Dark Warrior's Plate.description: Yggdrasil-grade black plate armor with sealed visor and full coverage. Joints reinforced for combat mobility.

Mask of Envy.name: Mask of Envy
Mask of Envy.description: A Yggdrasil Christmas event giveaway item, a carved wooden Barong mask from Bali, its fierce face fixed in a twisted expression that reads as either weeping or rage.

Houyi's Bow.name: Houyi's Bow
Houyi's Bow.description: A Yggdrasil divine-class composite bow that concentrates solar energy into a focused beam. Its frame appears wreathed in radiant golden light, as if perpetually alight.

Ghillie Cloak.name: Ghillie Cloak
Ghillie Cloak.description: A Yggdrasil legacy-class cloak woven with concealment enchantments that render the wearer blurry and difficult to track at range.

Haste Boots.name: Haste Boots
Haste Boots.description: Yggdrasil relic-class footwear enchanted to substantially increase the wearer's base movement speed.

Assassin's Dagger.name: Assassin's Dagger
Assassin's Dagger.description: A Yggdrasil dagger built for rapid attack sequences, capable of being thrown at extended range while retaining lethal precision.

Black Belt.name: Black Belt
Black Belt.description: A Yggdrasil relic-class belt associated with unarmed combat mastery, reinforcing the wearer's physical conditioning. It is plain, unadorned black, with no visible markings or fittings.

Grimoire.name: Grimoire
Grimoire.description: A Yggdrasil spellbook capable of storing a greater number of memorised spells than conventional magic.

Necklace of Heavy Recover.name: Necklace of Heavy Recover
Necklace of Heavy Recover.description: A Yggdrasil necklace enchanted to cast the 3rd-tier divine recovery spell Heavy Recover, drawing on the wearer's mana reserves. Its pendant is sculpted as a small goddess figure holding an emerald aloft.

Circlet of Iron Will.name: Circlet of Iron Will
Circlet of Iron Will.description: A reinforced circlet housing a mental fortification matrix. Enhances intelligence and mana reserves.

Book of the Dead.name: Book of the Dead
Book of the Dead.description: A Yggdrasil tome that enables racial advancement into undead class types.

Necroplasmic Mantle.name: Necroplasmic Mantle
Necroplasmic Mantle.description: A Yggdrasil relic-class mantle suffused with necroplasmic energy, enhancing the wearer's necrotic.

God Slaying Emperor Blade.name: God Slaying Emperor Blade
God Slaying Emperor Blade.description: A divine-class odachi -- a long single-edged two-handed Japanese sword -- exceeding 180 centimeters in length, forged to cut through magical armor and physical defenses alike.

Laevatein.name: Laevatein
Laevatein.description: A staff wreathed in perpetual flame that does not consume the wood beneath.

Keraunos MK 3.name: Keraunos MK 3
Keraunos MK 3.description: A staff with a golden core sheathed in a silver outer shell, built to discharge concentrated lightning.

Staff of the Elder Lich.name: Staff of the Elder Lich
Staff of the Elder Lich.description: A staff of blackened bone, its shaft shaped from a spine and capped with a grinning skull.

Dark Rapier.name: Dark Rapier
Dark Rapier.description: A slender thrusting sword imbued with dark elemental properties.

Nyoi Bo.name: Nyoi Bo
Nyoi Bo.description: A lunar-themed staff marked with celestial engravings that can freely extend or retract its length on command.

Gauntlets of Archery.name: Gauntlets of Archery
Gauntlets of Archery.description: Combat gauntlets with gold thread lining and red string binding at the joints and fingertips, constructed for ranged combat precision.

Geta of Strength.name: Geta of Strength
Geta of Strength.description: Traditional Japanese-style wooden clogs fitted with enchantments that amplify the wearer's physical strength.

Ring of Sustenance.name: Ring of Sustenance
Ring of Sustenance.description: A plain ring enchanted to suppress the biological needs of the wearer.

Ring of Mastery Wand.name: Ring of Mastery Wand
Ring of Mastery Wand.description: An ultra-rare ring worn on the thumb, shaped to channel control over wand-type weapons. It is a plain silver band set with a translucent green gem.

Infinite Backpack.name: Infinite Backpack
Infinite Backpack.description: A leather backpack indistinguishable from an ordinary pack, enchanted to hold far more than its exterior.

Ring of Freedom.name: Ring of Freedom
Ring of Freedom.description: A zero-resistance ring negating all binding effects. Allows sustained high-tier casting at close range.

Crimson Healing Potion.name: Crimson Healing Potion
Crimson Healing Potion.description: A sealed crystal vial containing a vivid crimson liquid of Yggdrasil game origin.

Dark Warrior's Gauntlets.name: Dark Warrior's Gauntlets
Dark Warrior's Gauntlets.description: Articulated full-finger gauntlets of blackened steel, matching the Dark Warrior plate set.

Dark Warrior's Greaves.name: Dark Warrior's Greaves
Dark Warrior's Greaves.description: Blackened steel leg guards and sabatons forming the lower body of the Dark Warrior plate set.

Lord's Robe.name: Lord's Robe
Lord's Robe.description: A floor-length robe of pure black enchanted fabric worn by undead magic lords.

Paladin's Visage.name: Paladin's Visage
Paladin's Visage.description: A winged great helm of polished silver steel with an engraved sunburst on the brow.

Ranger's Hood.name: Ranger's Hood
Ranger's Hood.description: A deep-cowled hood of oilskin canvas lined with soft wool.

Spellcaster's Gloves.name: Spellcaster's Gloves
Spellcaster's Gloves.description: Fine gloves threaded with reactive spellweave. Converts micro-gestures into precision casting amplifiers.

Shadow Gloves.name: Shadow Gloves
Shadow Gloves.description: Fingerless leather gloves dyed flat black, worn by scouts and thieves.

Iron Greaves.name: Iron Greaves
Iron Greaves.description: Standard military-issue iron leg armor covering shin and foot with riveted construction.

Steel Buckler.name: Steel Buckler
Steel Buckler.description: A round steel shield roughly forty centimeters in diameter with a central boss grip.

Sorcerer's Focus.name: Sorcerer's Focus
Sorcerer's Focus.description: A faceted crystal orb fifteen centimeters in diameter held in the off-hand during spellcasting to stabilize.

Copper Coin.name: Copper Coin
Copper Coin.description: The smallest standard denomination in the New World; thirteen copper coins equal one silver. About one in four is struck from brass rather than copper — same coin, same value. Stamped with the wheel symbol of the realm.

Silver Coin.name: Silver Coin
Silver Coin.description: The standard mid-value coin of the New World. One silver equals thirteen copper; one hundred silver equal one gold coin.

Gold Coin.name: Gold Coin
Gold Coin.description: The primary unit of account for significant transactions in the New World. Equal to one hundred silver coins. Three gold coins feed an ordinary family for a month.

Platinum Coin.name: Platinum Coin
Platinum Coin.description: A high-denomination coin equal to ten gold coins. Rare in daily transactions — the coin of merchants, nobles, and international trade.

Gemstone.name: Gemstone
Gemstone.description: A cut precious stone used as a portable store of value for very large transactions. Value scales with size and quality: lesser stones trade for a few gold coins, fine stones for tens of gold, exceptional pieces for a hundred gold or more. Some nations strike gemstones into gem coins of even higher denomination.

Exchange Box.name: Exchange Box
Exchange Box.description: A Yggdrasil device colloquially called a 'shredder'. Accepts bulk materials -- grain, ore, lumber, raw goods -- and converts them into Yggdrasil gold. It is a plain black rectangular box trimmed with a thin silver band along its edges.

Iron Helm.name: Iron Helm
Iron Helm.description: A simple iron helmet offering minimal but reliable head protection.

Traveler's Cloak.name: Traveler's Cloak
Traveler's Cloak.description: A heavy wool cloak in dark grey or brown, oiled to shed rain.

Leather Boots.name: Leather Boots
Leather Boots.description: Thick-soled leather boots built for hard travel. Ankle support, minimal ornamentation, stitched at the heel.

Iron Resolve Surcoat.name: Iron Resolve Surcoat
Iron Resolve Surcoat.description: A battle surcoat with segmented pauldrons. Outer layer deflects low-tier spell effects on contact.

Warbreaker Sabatons.name: Warbreaker Sabatons
Warbreaker Sabatons.description: Articulated plate sabatons with magnetized soles. Stability maintained on any terrain type.

Ring of Annihilation.name: Ring of Annihilation
Ring of Annihilation.description: A thick platinum band with a sunken rune. Physical blows carry additional structural force.

Nemean Gorget.name: Nemean Gorget
Nemean Gorget.description: A heavy gorget bearing an onyx lion-head relief. Exceptional endurance and health reserves.

Titan's Iron Gauntlets.name: Titan's Iron Gauntlets
Titan's Iron Gauntlets.description: Full-hand plate gauntlets with reinforced knuckle guards. Strike damage and grip force maximized.

Crusader's War Sabatons.name: Crusader's War Sabatons
Crusader's War Sabatons.description: Plate sabatons with divine inscription circuits along the ankle. Full combat movement at zero encumbrance.

Defender's War Mantle.name: Defender's War Mantle
Defender's War Mantle.description: Structured surcoat bearing an embossed crest. Physical resistance and nearby ally presence bonus.

Ring of the Crusader.name: Ring of the Crusader
Ring of the Crusader.description: A heavy signet ring with a cross motif on white metal. Enhances physical combat and tier magic for hybrid builds.

Holy Iron Gauntlets.name: Holy Iron Gauntlets
Holy Iron Gauntlets.description: Plated gauntlets with divine runes along the knuckle ridge. Strike force and restoration output both amplified.

Divine Edict.name: Divine Edict
Divine Edict.description: A longsword with a crystal-core blade emitting low-intensity holy light. Inflicts additional damage to undead.

Shadow Hunter's Helm.name: Shadow Hunter's Helm
Shadow Hunter's Helm.description: A deep hood with adaptive camouflage weave. Near-invisible when stationary at standard detection ranges.

Swift Hunt Buckler.name: Swift Hunt Buckler
Swift Hunt Buckler.description: A minimal buckler with matte-black absorptive surface. Reflects no light. Weight is negligible.

Stalker's Pendant.name: Stalker's Pendant
Stalker's Pendant.description: A pendant housing a refractive crystal that passively scatters all detection and tracking magic.

Ring of the Apex Hunter.name: Ring of the Apex Hunter
Ring of the Apex Hunter.description: A lightweight ring with a hollowed center. Markedly increases ranged accuracy and movement speed.

Bowmaster's Gauntlets.name: Bowmaster's Gauntlets
Bowmaster's Gauntlets.description: Fingerless gauntlets with friction-enhanced palm and reinforced archer's thumb guard. Eliminates bowstring drag.

Shadow Wraith Leathers.name: Shadow Wraith Leathers
Shadow Wraith Leathers.description: Close-cut armor from shadow-silk composite. Moves silently on all surfaces. Absorbs minor spell effects on contact.

Void-Touch Gloves.name: Void-Touch Gloves
Void-Touch Gloves.description: Gloves emitting zero thermal signature. Touch leaves no evidence. Grip enhancement under all conditions.

Ring of the Ghost.name: Ring of the Ghost
Ring of the Ghost.description: A thin silver band suppressing the wearer's signature across all passive detection and sensing systems.

Divine Bulwark.name: Divine Bulwark
Divine Bulwark.description: A kite shield with an embedded divine rune grid. Generates a minor blessing field around the wielder.

Robes of the High Cleric.name: Robes of the High Cleric
Robes of the High Cleric.description: Layered vestments bearing full-panel divine script. Passive healing aura radiates to nearby party members.

Ring of the High Cleric.name: Ring of the High Cleric
Ring of the High Cleric.description: A golden band with a restoration sigil face. Enhances both healing output and leadership presence.

Transmuter's Robes.name: Transmuter's Robes
Transmuter's Robes.description: Layered robes with integrated reagent pockets and reactive thermal shielding. Resists chemical contact damage.

Iron Clad Pendant.name: Iron Clad Pendant
Iron Clad Pendant.description: A heavy iron pendant worn close to the chest. The weight is part of its design -- grounds combat stance.

Iron Fist Gauntlets.name: Iron Fist Gauntlets
Iron Fist Gauntlets.description: Gauntlets built to maximize unarmed strike force. Knuckle structure reinforced beyond any known material limits.

Siegemage War Boots.name: Siegemage War Boots
Siegemage War Boots.description: Plate boots with shock-absorption layering. Designed to maintain footing while taking melee hits during casting.

True Resurrection Wand.name: True Resurrection Wand
True Resurrection Wand.description: Complete restoration wand capable of reversing death up to 200 elapsed in-game days. No stat penalties applied.

Conqueror's Plate Helm.name: Conqueror's Plate Helm
Conqueror's Plate Helm.description: Full-face plate helm with flanged ridge crest. Composite alloy unavailable in the New World.

Adventurer's Pack.name: Adventurer's Pack
Adventurer's Pack.description: A sturdy canvas pack containing rope, torches, and basic camp supplies. Standard issue for registered adventurers.

Antidote.name: Antidote
Antidote.description: A bitter tincture that neutralises common toxins. Widely available from apothecaries.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.description: An enchanted bag whose interior volume exceeds its outer dimensions. Carries far more than its size suggests.

Frost Pain.name: Frost Pain
Frost Pain.description: A two-handed sword with a blade perpetually coated in a layer of ice. Strikes inflict cold damage.

Health Potion.name: Health Potion
Health Potion.description: A common New World healing flask, its liquid the dull blue of local alchemy, sold across the markets. Restores a modest amount of health on use.

Holy Sword Kilineyram.name: Holy Sword Kilineyram
Holy Sword Kilineyram.description: A longsword radiating a persistent holy field. One of the few New World blades rated as a national treasure.

Mithril Sword.name: Mithril Sword
Mithril Sword.description: A finely balanced sword forged from mithril. Lighter than steel with superior edge retention.

Morningstar of Shattering.name: Morningstar of Shattering
Morningstar of Shattering.description: A heavy morningstar whose flanged head delivers concussive force sufficient to shatter armor plate.

Rations.name: Rations
Rations.description: Dried provisions sufficient for several days of travel. Tasteless but effective.

Sniper Crossbow.name: Sniper Crossbow
Sniper Crossbow.description: A precision crossbow with extended draw and optical sight assembly. Effective at extreme range.

Teleportation Scroll.name: Teleportation Scroll
Teleportation Scroll.description: A single-use scroll encoded with a teleportation sigil. Returns the user to a pre-set anchor point on activation.

Sorcerer's Gauntlets.name: Sorcerer's Gauntlets
Sorcerer's Gauntlets.description: Long fitted gloves of obsidian-black material with violet rune-thread along the knuckles. Standard component of the Sorcerer King's formal attire.

Sorcerer's Boots.name: Sorcerer's Boots
Sorcerer's Boots.description: Long pointed boots in jet-black with violet trim, formed from the same enchanted fabric as Lord's Robe.

Sorcerer's Hood.name: Sorcerer's Hood
Sorcerer's Hood.description: A hooded cowl in matching jet-black with violet edging. Sits over the wearer's face and obscures expression beneath the shadow of the cowl.

Armor of Pure Silver.name: Armor of Pure Silver
Armor of Pure Silver.description: A full suit of shining platinum-white plate, a great sapphire set over the sternum, worn by the Paladin of Pure Silver. It radiates a faint holy light and turns aside the worst of any blow.

Helm of Pure Silver.name: Helm of Pure Silver
Helm of Pure Silver.description: A platinum-white helm shaped to its wearer's chosen race, a visor of mirror-bright metal. It wards the mind as well as the skull.

Gauntlets of Pure Silver.name: Gauntlets of Pure Silver
Gauntlets of Pure Silver.description: Articulated platinum plate gauntlets that lend a paladin's grip the strength to crush and the steadiness to never fumble a strike.

Sabatons of Pure Silver.name: Sabatons of Pure Silver
Sabatons of Pure Silver.description: Heavy platinum sabatons that plant their wearer like a fortress wall, immovable against charge or throw.

Sapphire Aegis.name: Sapphire Aegis
Sapphire Aegis.description: A great kite shield of silver-white metal set with a sapphire twin to the one on the breastplate. It turns aside blows meant for allies as readily as its bearer.

World Champion Medal.name: World Champion Medal
World Champion Medal.description: The medal granted to the single player who won Yggdrasil's grand martial tournament. It confers the World Champion class and its signature combat arts; only one exists per server.

Blade of Pure Silver.name: Blade of Pure Silver
Blade of Pure Silver.description: A greatsword of silver-white metal wielded by the guild's founding paladin. Its edge carries a holy enchantment devastating to the undead and the wicked.

Suit of Great Disaster.name: Suit of Great Disaster
Suit of Great Disaster.description: A form-fitting black suit and velvet cape worn by the Demon of Great Disaster, a rose pinned at the lapel. Woven with fire-warding enchantments and the residue of world-scale destructive magic.

Ulbert's Cane.name: Ulbert's Cane
Ulbert's Cane.description: A slender black cane that serves as a casting focus for the guild's foremost offensive mage. Channels world-class fire and destruction magic with terrible efficiency.

Sign of the Demon Lord.name: Sign of the Demon Lord
Sign of the Demon Lord.description: An infernal sigil borne by Ulbert Alain Odle. It sharpens the bite of every destructive spell and marks its bearer as a caster of catastrophe.

Bow of Explosive Strikes.name: Bow of Explosive Strikes
Bow of Explosive Strikes.description: The great bow of the Winged King of Explosive Strikes. Each loosed arrow detonates on impact, and its draw is faster than any eye can follow.

Feathered War-Raiment.name: Feathered War-Raiment
Feathered War-Raiment.description: Light layered garb fitted to a winged birdman frame, cut for speed and unhindered flight over defense. Marked with the plumage-crests of a heteromorph archer.

Quiver of the Winged King.name: Quiver of the Winged King
Quiver of the Winged King.description: An endless quiver of explosive-tipped arrows, each one enchanted to burst with force on contact. It never empties.

Mantle of the Unsinkable.name: Mantle of the Unsinkable
Mantle of the Unsinkable.description: A layered carapace of hardened slime-flesh that absorbs and disperses force rather than resisting it, earning its wearer the title 'The Unsinkable.' Blows sink in and vanish.

Protean Core.name: Protean Core
Protean Core.description: The shifting inner mass of a shapeshifting slime, letting its bearer reform wounds as fast as they are dealt and take on shapes and voices at will.

Enveloping Grasp.name: Enveloping Grasp
Enveloping Grasp.description: Amorphous slime-limbs that engulf and crush what they seize. There is no blade to parry and no grip to break.

The Emerald Tablet.name: The Emerald Tablet
The Emerald Tablet.description: The legendary alchemical codex from which the Great Alchemist takes his name. Its pages hold transmutations and summonings no New World scholar has dreamed of, and it answers its bearer's thought before the page is turned.

Silver-Studded Leathers.name: Silver-Studded Leathers
Silver-Studded Leathers.description: A shiny, form-fitting black leather outfit studded with silver jewelry, worn by the Great Alchemist. The silver is warded and reactive, storing spellcraft against need.

Alchemist's Endless Reagents.name: Alchemist's Endless Reagents
Alchemist's Endless Reagents.description: A self-replenishing case of rare reagents and catalysts. Whatever a transmutation or summoning demands, it is already inside.

Crimson Samurai Armor.name: Crimson Samurai Armor
Crimson Samurai Armor.description: A full set of dark red samurai armor with a kabuto crested like a crescent moon, worn by the Samurai. Laquered plates turn aside blows a lesser guard would never stop.

Blade of No Second Strike.name: Blade of No Second Strike
Blade of No Second Strike.description: The great katana of the warrior who never needs a second cut. Its draw and stroke are a single motion, and what it opens does not close.

Warrior's Resolve Charm.name: Warrior's Resolve Charm
Warrior's Resolve Charm.description: A battle charm carried by a duelist who has never lost. It steadies the hand and sharpens the read of an opponent's opening.

Corrosive Ooze Body.name: Corrosive Ooze Body
Corrosive Ooze Body.description: The roiling tar-like mass of an Elder Black Ooze, one of the strongest slime races. Weapons sink in and dissolve; the body simply flows back together.

Dissolving Grasp.name: Dissolving Grasp
Dissolving Grasp.description: A lashing pseudopod of black acid that eats through armor, flesh, and stone alike. What it holds does not stay whole.

Elder Ooze Core.name: Elder Ooze Core
Elder Ooze Core.description: The dense inner nucleus of an ancient slime, driving relentless regeneration and letting its bearer split, reform, and endure blows that would end anything solid.

Robe of the Strategist.name: Robe of the Strategist
Robe of the Strategist.description: A priest's robe draped over a frame of living Death Vines. It wards the mind against confusion and steadies the will of everyone who fights beneath its wearer's command.

Staff of Death Vines.name: Staff of Death Vines
Staff of Death Vines.description: A gnarled staff of writhing black vines that lash out to bind and strangle, and that focuses the control and support magic of a master tactician.

Feather War-Fan.name: Feather War-Fan
Feather War-Fan.description: A white feather fan carried by the guild's chief strategist, in the manner of a legendary field commander. A wave of it reads a battle three moves ahead.

Shinobi Shozoku.name: Shinobi Shozoku
Shinobi Shozoku.description: The stereotypical black ninja garb of a master shinobi, paired with an unsettling mask. It swallows sound and shadow, leaving its wearer all but unseen until the moment they choose otherwise.

Twin Ninjato.name: Twin Ninjato
Twin Ninjato.description: A matched pair of short straight swords carried at the waist. In a shinobi's hands they open a throat before the body knows the fight has started.

Shinobi's Trick-Pouch.name: Shinobi's Trick-Pouch
Shinobi's Trick-Pouch.description: A bottomless pouch of shuriken, smoke bombs, caltrops, and hidden tools -- and the trap-craft of a ninja who wired the tomb's own snares.

Circlet of Ruin.name: Circlet of Ruin
Circlet of Ruin.description: A thin band of blackened metal that focuses a caster's will, worn by the Demon of Great Disaster. It hardens the mind against counter-magic.

Gloves of the Cataclysm.name: Gloves of the Cataclysm
Gloves of the Cataclysm.description: Fine dark gloves that channel destructive magic without burning their wearer, letting spells leave the hand faster and hotter.

Boots of the Demon.name: Boots of the Demon
Boots of the Demon.description: Cloven-hoof boots of black leather that let a demon caster keep the distance a caster needs.

Orb of World-Fire.name: Orb of World-Fire
Orb of World-Fire.description: A smouldering orb held in the off-hand, brimming with the residue of world-scale destruction. It amplifies every spell of fire and ruin.

Beaked War-Helm.name: Beaked War-Helm
Beaked War-Helm.description: A light helm shaped to a birdman's crested skull, open at the beak, sharpening sight and hearing for a hunter of the skies.

Archer's Bracers.name: Archer's Bracers
Archer's Bracers.description: Reinforced bracers that steady a bow-arm through the fastest volley and guard the wrist against the snap of the string.

Winged Talon-Boots.name: Winged Talon-Boots
Winged Talon-Boots.description: Light taloned boots fitted to clawed feet, built for launching into flight and landing without a sound.

Unsinkable Crown.name: Unsinkable Crown
Unsinkable Crown.description: A dense nodule of hardened slime crowning the mass, absorbing blows to the head as readily as the body swallows a blade.

Enveloping Fists.name: Enveloping Fists
Enveloping Fists.description: Fists of hardened slime that both strike and cushion, dispersing force through the whole mass on impact.

Anchored Base.name: Anchored Base
Anchored Base.description: A broad, weighted lower mass that roots the Unsinkable in place; nothing shifts it that it does not allow.

Circlet of the Emerald.name: Circlet of the Emerald
Circlet of the Emerald.description: A thin emerald-set circlet worn by the Great Alchemist, focusing the mind for delicate transmutation.

Transmuter's Gloves.name: Transmuter's Gloves
Transmuter's Gloves.description: Fine gloves whose fingertips reshape matter at a touch, wielded by an alchemist of the first rank.

Alchemist's Treads.name: Alchemist's Treads
Alchemist's Treads.description: Silver-buckled boots that carry a scholar unhurried through his own laboratory of the world.

Homunculus Vessel.name: Homunculus Vessel
Homunculus Vessel.description: A sealed alchemical flask in the off-hand, brimming with reagents and half-formed summonings that answer a word.

Crescent Kabuto.name: Crescent Kabuto
Crescent Kabuto.description: A dark red samurai helm crested like a crescent moon, matching its wearer's uneven horns.

Samurai Kote.name: Samurai Kote
Samurai Kote.description: Lacquered red arm-guards that lend a duelist's stroke its terrible, unhurried certainty.

Samurai Suneate.name: Samurai Suneate
Samurai Suneate.description: Heavy red shin-guards that root a swordsman's stance against any charge.

Wakizashi of No Second Strike.name: Wakizashi of No Second Strike
Wakizashi of No Second Strike.description: The companion short-blade to the great katana, drawn only when a fight has already been decided.

Ooze-Mass Crown.name: Ooze-Mass Crown
Ooze-Mass Crown.description: A dense hardened nodule crowning the black ooze, absorbing head-blows as readily as the body swallows a blade.

Corrosive Fists.name: Corrosive Fists
Corrosive Fists.description: Fists of hardened acidic slime that both guard and eat through whatever they strike.

Anchoring Sludge.name: Anchoring Sludge
Anchoring Sludge.description: A broad, weighted base of dense ooze that fixes the Ancient Black Slime immovably in place.

Strategist's Cowl.name: Strategist's Cowl
Strategist's Cowl.description: A plain priest's cowl over a frame of Death Vines, steadying the will of everyone the strategist commands.

Vine-Wrapped Gloves.name: Vine-Wrapped Gloves
Vine-Wrapped Gloves.description: Gloves of living vine that lash out to bind at range and focus control magic.

Rooted Sandals.name: Rooted Sandals
Rooted Sandals.description: Sandals that sink roots into any ground, anchoring a caster mid-battle.

Command Talisman.name: Command Talisman
Command Talisman.description: A field-commander's talisman held in the off-hand, extending the strategist's control over allies across a battlefield.

Shinobi Hood.name: Shinobi Hood
Shinobi Hood.description: A black shinobi hood and unsettling mask that swallow a face into shadow.

Wrapped Hands.name: Wrapped Hands
Wrapped Hands.description: Hand-wraps for a silent killer, guarding the knuckles and quieting every grip.

Tabi Boots.name: Tabi Boots
Tabi Boots.description: Split-toe tabi boots that cross any surface without a sound.

Off-Hand Ninjato.name: Off-Hand Ninjato
Off-Hand Ninjato.description: The second of a matched pair of short straight blades, drawn to finish what the first began.

Horn of the Goblin General.name: Horn of the Goblin General
Horn of the Goblin General.description: An expendable Yggdrasil summoning horn -- a simply made horn of pale ivory, most of its length left bare, a slim band of ornate metalwork wrapped near the mouthpiece and a leather carrying strap attached. When sounded it calls forth a troop of goblins to fight for whoever blew it: twelve soldiers, two archers, a mage, a priest, two wolf riders, and a leader. Under the right conditions it summons a far larger goblin army instead. It cannot be sounded again once spent.

Magic Arrow.name: Magic Arrow
Magic Arrow.description: Fire a concentrated bolt of magical energy at a single target. The most basic offensive spell — reliable, low cost, and effective at short to medium range.

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description: Tier 1 darkness magic. Project a zone that suppresses natural and magical light in a small area; targets inside cannot see, but casters with Darkvision are unaffected. The baseline darkness spell available to any trained caster.

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description: Reduce the movement speed and action economy of a single target. A simple but effective control spell at close range.

Minor Heal.name: Minor Heal
Minor Heal.description: Channel positive energy to restore a small amount of health to the target. Negative energy beings take damage instead. The most basic healing technique.

Fly.name: Fly
Fly.description: Sustain magical flight indefinitely at will. Speed and maneuverability exceed any non-magical means of aerial movement available in the New World. The caster remains fully capable of casting while airborne. Vertical positioning in combat provides a tactical advantage against ground-bound opponents with no ranged or flight capability of their own.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Tier 3 fire-element magic. Project a sphere of concentrated fire that detonates on impact, covering a wide area. The standard adventurer-grade combat spell; common among trained New World casters and a workhorse of Yggdrasil spellcasters.

Web.name: Web
Web.description: Fill an area with rapidly hardening magical webbing that immobilizes multiple targets. Targets can break free with sufficient strength, but it costs actions.

Silence.name: Silence
Silence.description: Create a zone of complete magical silence. Verbal spell components cannot be spoken, effectively preventing most spellcasting by targets inside.

Lightning.name: Lightning
Lightning.description: Call a powerful bolt of electrical energy to strike a target. High damage with area chain potential. The archetypal Tier 3 offensive spell.

Protection from Arrows.name: Protection from Arrows
Protection from Arrows.description: Create a magical barrier that deflects normal ranged projectiles. Does not stop magical or siege-scale attacks.

Enhance Magic.name: Enhance Magic
Enhance Magic.description: Amplify the next spell cast, increasing its effective power tier by a partial step. Increases mana cost of the enhanced spell proportionally.

Force Explosion.name: Force Explosion
Force Explosion.description: Detonate a concentrated pocket of magical force at a target location. The kinetic damage passes through most physical armor. Wide blast radius at this tier.

Negative Burst.name: Negative Burst
Negative Burst.description: Release a close-range burst of concentrated negative energy. All living targets within the radius sustain heavy damage; undead targets within range are healed. No casting delay - functions as an immediate reaction when enemies close to melee range. Does not discriminate between targets. Not suitable when allies are present within the burst radius.

Animate Dead.name: Animate Dead
Animate Dead.description: Raise fallen enemies and neutral corpses as undead servants. More permanent than Summon Undead spells — the raised undead continue until destroyed.

Greater Telekinesis.name: Greater Telekinesis
Greater Telekinesis.description: Move very large objects — up to several tons — with directed magical force. Can be used offensively to hurl structures or defensively to erect barriers.

Call Greater Thunder.name: Call Greater Thunder
Call Greater Thunder.description: Call a cascading storm of lightning bolts across a wide area. Each target in the zone receives multiple strikes. One of the most effective mass-damage spells in human reach.

Command Undead.name: Command Undead
Command Undead.description: Seize direct control of undead creatures within range. The controlled undead follow orders as long as the caster maintains concentration. Does not work on undead of far greater power than the caster.

Summon Undead 5th.name: Summon Undead 5th
Summon Undead 5th.description: Summon powerful undead warriors — death knights, powerful skeletons, or wights — to serve under the caster's command. Significantly more capable than third-tier summons.

Telekinetic Cluster.name: Telekinetic Cluster
Telekinetic Cluster.description: Surround the caster with a field of objects launched simultaneously in a burst pattern. Effective crowd control and damage combination.

Reality Slash.name: Reality Slash
Reality Slash.description: Cut through magical defenses and physical barriers as though they do not exist. Slices the air itself, creating a tear that passes through most forms of protection.

Mass Teleportation.name: Mass Teleportation
Mass Teleportation.description: Teleport the caster and a group of willing subjects to a prepared or known location instantly. Requires line of sight or a prepared magical beacon at the destination.

Explode.name: Explode
Explode.description: Cause a target's internal structure to violently destabilize from inside. An area effect that works from within the target, bypassing external defenses.

Widen Magic.name: Widen Magic
Widen Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that expands the area of effect of any subsequent spell significantly. The next spell cast after Widen Magic is activated affects a substantially larger radius than normal. Particularly effective when combined with area spells - a widened Fallen Down covers ground that would otherwise require multiple casts. No bonus to the base spell's power - purely a coverage modifier.

Maximize Magic.name: Maximize Magic
Maximize Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that pushes the next spell cast to its maximum possible output - every variable component of the spell's effect resolves at its highest value instead of being rolled or scaled. The amplification costs substantially more mana than a normal casting of the same spell. Purely a power modifier: range, area, and duration are unchanged. Commonly chained with other metamagic modifiers by casters trained in the Yggdrasil tradition.

Silent Magic.name: Silent Magic
Silent Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that lets the next spell activate without any spoken incantation. Eliminates the risk of a third party disrupting the casting and gives no audible warning of what is coming. The spell's effect is unchanged - purely a delivery modifier prized for ambushes, negotiations, and any situation where revealing a casting would be costly.

Penetrate Magic.name: Penetrate Magic
Penetrate Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that sharpens the next spell's ability to punch through magical defenses, increasing its chance to breach spell resistance and protective wards. The spell's raw power is unchanged - what improves is how much of it arrives on the far side of the target's defenses. The standard answer to heavily warded opponents.

Boost Magic.name: Boost Magic
Boost Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that elevates the tier and power of the next spell cast, letting it hit above its normal rank. Costlier than Maximize Magic and rarer in practice, because pushing a spell beyond its designed tier strains both the casting and the caster. Used when a caster needs an answer one tier heavier than anything currently prepared.

Delay Magic.name: Delay Magic
Delay Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that postpones the activation of the next spell cast: the magic is committed now but takes effect at a chosen later moment. The foundation of traps, feints, and timed combinations - an opponent who watched the casting must still guess when the effect will actually land.

Extend Magic.name: Extend Magic
Extend Magic.description: Apply a metamagic modifier that lengthens the duration of the next spell cast, keeping buffs, wards, and sustained effects active well beyond their normal window. No change to the spell's strength - purely a duration modifier, and the economical choice for casters maintaining long defensive rotations.

Dragon Lightning.name: Dragon Lightning
Dragon Lightning.description: A tier 5 spell that releases a lightning bolt in the coiling form of a dragon, which then seeks out its designated target. The bolt tracks evasive movement rather than travelling in a straight line, making it far harder to dodge than ordinary lightning magic. A signature mid-tier attack of the Yggdrasil casting tradition.

Napalm.name: Napalm
Napalm.description: A tier 7 spell that conjures a column of clinging flame directly beside the target, engulfing it in fire that burns on after the initial eruption. The flame adheres to whatever it touches, making it brutal against targets that rely on retreating or regenerating through damage.

Body of Effulgent Beryl.name: Body of Effulgent Beryl
Body of Effulgent Beryl.description: A tier 10 defensive spell that sheathes the subject in a gem-like radiance, reducing the effectiveness of all bludgeoning attacks for its duration and completely negating one bludgeoning blow outright. The negated strike can be of any magnitude - the ward absorbs it whole and is consumed by it. Standard preparation among top-tier casters expecting to face crushing physical force.

Instantaneous Flash.name: Instantaneous Flash
Instantaneous Flash.description: A martial art allowing an attack at extreme speed — faster than most opponents can track and respond to. Developed through repetitive practice taken to an obsessive degree. Requires mastery of the physical combat form.

God Flash.name: God Flash
God Flash.description: The perfected evolution of Instantaneous Flash, born from practicing that single motion until it transcends technique - a cut so fast that blood does not stick to the blade. The strike arrives before any conventional reaction and leaves the sword clean. Among the highest expressions of pure speed a swordsman can reach without magic.

Teleportation.name: Teleportation
Teleportation.description: Tier 5 spatial magic. Instantly transport the caster to any previously visited or known location within the continent; blocked by anti-teleportation wards. The foundation of long-range Nazarick logistics; Yggdrasil standard, accessible to top-tier New World casters.

Aspect of the Devil.name: Aspect of the Devil
Aspect of the Devil.description: Transform partially into a demonic form, gaining additional appendages, enhanced physical power, and access to demonic special attacks. Alters appearance significantly.

Thousand Swords.name: Thousand Swords
Thousand Swords.description: Manifest a swarm of magical blades that simultaneously attack multiple targets. Each blade strikes independently — the spell is effective against groups.

Gravity Maelstrom.name: Gravity Maelstrom
Gravity Maelstrom.description: Create a zone of variable gravity around the target, rapidly shifting directions to disorient and damage any creature caught inside.

Delay Teleportation.name: Delay Teleportation
Delay Teleportation.description: Establish a field that prevents teleportation in and out of the target area for a sustained duration. Essential tactical spell against enemies who rely on rapid repositioning.

Vermilion Nova.name: Vermilion Nova
Vermilion Nova.description: Manifest a concentrated sphere of solar-intensity heat that expands rapidly. Targets within range are immersed in temperatures that bypass most fire resistance. One of the most destructive Tier 8 spells.

Obsidian Sword.name: Obsidian Sword
Obsidian Sword.description: Summon a massive black sword of crystallized magical energy, forty times the size of a normal blade, to strike a single target with overwhelming force.

Mass Blindness.name: Mass Blindness
Mass Blindness.description: Strip vision from all enemies in a wide area simultaneously. The blindness persists unless removed by specific counter-magic. Devastating against enemies who depend on sight.

Fallen Down.name: Fallen Down
Fallen Down.description: A super-tier spell that calls down an immense pillar of searing blue-white light from the sky onto a designated area. At the moment of impact the light burns so bright and hot that the whole world appears to turn white. When it fades, seconds later, everything within the area has been burned to cinder - ground scorched bare, nothing left alive. Deals massive damage to everything caught in the pillar; the devastation of the terrain is total and lasting.

Avarice and Generosity.name: Avarice and Generosity
Avarice and Generosity.description: Simultaneously apply opposing gravitational forces — one drawing all matter in, one repelling it — creating a rapidly alternating field that tears apart whatever is caught between them.

True Death.name: True Death
True Death.description: Apply an effect that prevents resurrection, resurrection magic, and undead transformation on a target. Death becomes permanent. The counter to enemies who rely on revival.

Implosion.name: Implosion
Implosion.description: Compress a target's physical structure into a rapidly decreasing volume. Organic and inorganic matter alike are destroyed by the collapsing field.

Ia Shub-Niggurath.name: Ia Shub-Niggurath
Ia Shub-Niggurath.description: A super-tier ritual that sacrifices living victims to summon seven Evileye-class Evil Lords under the caster's permanent command. Each Lord is a sovereign-tier entity in its own right. The ritual requires a sufficient number of living sacrifices to complete - the result is seven independent commanders who operate indefinitely without further mana cost. One of the highest-output summons available in the Yggdrasil spell catalogue.

Sword of Damocles.name: Sword of Damocles
Sword of Damocles.description: Manifest an enormous blade of pure magical energy above the target area and release it with the full weight of magical gravity behind it. Area destruction on a city-block scale.

Creation.name: Creation
Creation.description: Generate matter from magical energy — permanent creation of physical substances. Requires extended preparation and immense mana. The most demanding utility Super-Tier spell.

Long Distance Teleportation.name: Long Distance Teleportation
Long Distance Teleportation.description: Transport the caster and companions across continental distances without requiring a prepared destination beacon. The only form of teleportation that functions at this range.

Wish Upon a Star.name: Wish Upon a Star
Wish Upon a Star.description: The highest-tier wish spell in the Yggdrasil catalogue. Capable of replicating virtually any magical effect or altering reality within its scope. Restrictions apply: wishes that would contradict fundamental world physics, affect beings beyond a power threshold, or violate the game's internal consistency rules are rejected or partially fulfilled. Mana cost is severe. Used for effects that no other spell can produce rather than as a combat tool.

Flow Acceleration.name: Flow Acceleration
Flow Acceleration.description: Enter a state of inhuman speed for a brief burst, closing the distance to an opponent or evading attacks that would otherwise connect.

Triple Strike.name: Triple Strike
Triple Strike.description: Deliver three rapid strikes in sequence against a single target or spread across multiple adjacent enemies. Each strike is individually aimed.

Fortress.name: Fortress
Fortress.description: Defensive martial art that absorbs and offsets incoming attacks. Does not require a shield — can be used with a weapon, bare hands, or armor, but timing must be exact. A mistimed activation leaves the user completely open.

Instant Counter.name: Instant Counter
Instant Counter.description: React to an incoming attack with a perfect parry, using the attacker's momentum to deliver a precise riposte in the same motion. Higher skill level improves both defense and counter-damage.

Shooting Star.name: Shooting Star
Shooting Star.description: Launch into a high-speed dash covering great distance, striking a target at the end of the movement with full momentum behind the blow.

Power Attack.name: Power Attack
Power Attack.description: Sacrifice precision for maximum force — a slow but devastating strike that ignores a portion of the target's armor rating.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Drive a shield into the target with full body weight, stunning them briefly and creating an opening for follow-up attacks.

Precise Strike.name: Precise Strike
Precise Strike.description: Target an exposed joint, gap in armor, or weak point for a strike that deals enhanced damage against armored opponents.

Defensive Formation.name: Defensive Formation
Defensive Formation.description: Coordinate with nearby allies to establish overlapping defensive coverage, reducing damage taken by the group.

Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
Shadow Step.description: Move instantly between two points of deep shadow. Requires shadow at both origin and destination. Movement is silent and leaves no physical trace.

Vanish.name: Vanish
Vanish.description: Temporarily suppress your physical presence — sound, light reflection, and scent — for a limited duration. Any offensive action breaks the effect.

Silent Kill.name: Silent Kill
Silent Kill.description: Execute a target in a manner that produces no sound and minimal visible evidence. Requires the target to be unaware and accessible.

Rally.name: Rally
Rally.description: Issue a commanding call that restores morale and combat focus to nearby allies. Reduces the effect of fear and fatigue temporarily.

Tactical Command.name: Tactical Command
Tactical Command.description: Coordinate allied attacks to converge on a single point, or redirect defensive coverage in response to a threat. Effective only with willing allies in auditory range.

Supreme Presence.name: Supreme Presence
Supreme Presence.description: Project an overwhelming aura of authority that forces enemies to hesitate before acting. Lesser beings may flee entirely. Higher-tier beings are resistant.

Track.name: Track
Track.description: Follow a creature or person's trail through terrain. More skilled use reveals passage time and creature type.

Forage.name: Forage
Forage.description: Find sufficient food and water in wilderness terrain to sustain a small group for one day.

Brew Potion.name: Brew Potion
Brew Potion.description: Create a functional health or mana potion from available materials. Requires base alchemical supplies. Quality increases with skill level.

Enchant Item.name: Enchant Item
Enchant Item.description: Apply a temporary magical enhancement to a piece of equipment. Duration and potency scale with crafting skill.

Inscribe Rune.name: Inscribe Rune
Inscribe Rune.description: Carve a magical rune onto a surface or item that activates under specified conditions. A slower but more permanent form of magical enhancement.

Light.name: Light
Light.description: Project a sustained light source from a point or surface. Intensity and colour adjustable. The baseline utility spell for work in dark environments. Every trained mage knows it; non-mages recognise it as a sign of basic magical training.

Acid Splash.name: Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description: Launch a small quantity of magical acid at a target. Effective against organic materials and certain metals. The acid is magically produced and cannot be neutralised by mundane means. Tier 1 — adequate damage at very close range.

Detect Evil.name: Detect Evil
Detect Evil.description: Extend magical perception to detect malicious intent, negative magical alignment, and undead presence within a short radius. The detection is of alignment and intent, not species. A well-intended undead being would not register. Rarely used because this situation is rare.

Mana Essence.name: Mana Essence
Mana Essence.description: Detect the presence and approximate intensity of magical energy in the immediate area. Useful for locating magical items, active enchantments, and beings with significant mana reserves. Does not identify the type or source of the magic — only that it exists and approximately how strong.

Minor Healing.name: Minor Healing
Minor Healing.description: Channel a small quantity of divine or natural healing energy into a recipient. Closes minor wounds, reduces inflammation, counteracts the initial shock of injury. The baseline healing spell — effective for scratches, bruises, and minor lacerations. Not suitable for serious injury.

Fire Arrow.name: Fire Arrow
Fire Arrow.description: Launch a directed bolt of magical fire at a single target. Greater damage than Magic Arrow against targets without fire resistance. Less reliable against fire-immune creatures. Leaves a brief burn effect. Standard offensive upgrade from Tier 1 for combat mages.

Ice Needle.name: Ice Needle
Ice Needle.description: Project a needle of supercooled ice at a single target. High precision, low splash. The ice carries a penetration enchantment that allows it to punch through soft armour. The cold is a secondary effect — the physical impact is the primary damage mechanism.

Lesser Healing.name: Lesser Healing
Lesser Healing.description: Channel healing energy sufficient to address moderate injuries. Closes lacerations, reduces fracture pain, addresses internal bleeding at a minor level. The standard adventurer healer's workhorse — effective enough to keep a party functional through normal dungeon encounters.

Enhance Magic Weapon.name: Enhance Magic Weapon
Enhance Magic Weapon.description: Temporarily enchant a weapon with a magical edge and impact enhancement. The enchantment raises the weapon's effective tier for penetrating magical defences and dealing damage. Duration is limited. Useful in encounters where unenchanted weapons are ineffective.

Greater Darkness.name: Greater Darkness
Greater Darkness.description: Tier 4 darkness magic. Project an expanded zone of darkness that suppresses magical light sources including those produced by items; beings with Darkvision still operate inside. New World casters reaching this tier are exceptional; Yggdrasil Players use it routinely.

Confusion.name: Confusion
Confusion.description: Afflict a target with disorientation and irrational behaviour. The affected being cannot distinguish ally from enemy for the duration. An effective disruption tool in coordinated enemy formations — a confused tank charge is a significant liability to the enemy's side.

Ice Storm.name: Ice Storm
Ice Storm.description: Produce a sustained storm of magical ice and cold wind in a targeted area. Both cold damage and physical impact from ice projectiles. Area persists for several seconds. Effective crowd control combined with damage — targets in the storm are also slowed by the cold.

Greater Healing.name: Greater Healing
Greater Healing.description: Channel significant healing energy into a recipient. Closes serious wounds, addresses internal injuries, counteracts shock. The standard of care for injuries that would be disabling without magical treatment. Effective for keeping a party functional after a serious encounter.

Greater Magic Weapon.name: Greater Magic Weapon
Greater Magic Weapon.description: A more powerful version of Enhance Magic Weapon. The enchantment raises the weapon's effective tier more significantly and for a longer duration. At this level, mundane weapons can bypass magical barriers that would stop standard equipment. Favoured by physical fighters who work alongside mages.

Mass Slow.name: Mass Slow
Mass Slow.description: Apply the Slow effect to multiple targets simultaneously within a targeted area. Movement speed and action rate reduced across the affected group. A combat control spell that changes the timing of an engagement — slowed enemies take their turns late, get hit more, and lose initiative advantages.

Void Magic.name: Void Magic
Void Magic.description: A specialised discipline of magic that targets magical energy directly rather than physical or elemental targets. Void spells can drain mana from opponents, suppress enchantments, and disrupt spell casting. Fluder Paradyne's research field. Rare knowledge outside of dedicated study.

Greater Fireball.name: Greater Fireball
Greater Fireball.description: Tier 5 fire-element magic. An expanded Fireball with a significantly larger blast radius and higher fire damage; the explosion can clear small formations. Fire resistance calibrated for a standard Fireball is insufficient. Reachable only by exceptional New World casters; standard for Yggdrasil Players.

Mass Lesser Healing.name: Mass Lesser Healing
Mass Lesser Healing.description: Apply the Lesser Healing effect to all allied targets within a radius simultaneously. Less potent per target than a direct Lesser Healing, but the coverage makes it invaluable in group combat situations where multiple party members are injured simultaneously.

Life Essence.name: Life Essence
Life Essence.description: Perceive the vital force and precise health state of any living target within sight range. Returns an exact reading on targets without active magical concealment: current health, maximum health, and visible status effects. Passive when not suppressed. Used as a standard assessment tool before committing to any engagement - knowing the exact margin a target has remaining changes every decision that follows.

Crystal Bolt.name: Crystal Bolt
Crystal Bolt.description: Launch a bolt of magically crystallised force that penetrates magical shielding. The crystallisation effect causes the bolt to pass through low-to-mid-tier magical barriers rather than being stopped by them. Evileye's signature attack spell.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description: Release a primary lightning bolt that arcs from the initial target to additional nearby targets in sequence. Each successive arc carries slightly less power. Effective against clustered enemy formations. The arc selection is partially random — targets at similar distances from the prior arc point have equal probability of being struck.

Greater Teleportation.name: Greater Teleportation
Greater Teleportation.description: Tier 7 spatial magic. Transport the caster plus companions across longer distances and to locations known only by description rather than direct experience. Effectively Yggdrasil-Player-exclusive in the New World; only the most extraordinary native casters could approach this tier.

Mass Confusion.name: Mass Confusion
Mass Confusion.description: Apply the Confusion effect to all targets in a wide area simultaneously. A formation-breaking spell — entire enemy groups stop distinguishing friend from foe. Effective in pitched battle scenarios. Requires precise placement to avoid affecting allied targets.

Hell Flame.name: Hell Flame
Hell Flame.description: Demiurge's characteristic spell. Flames produced by demonic energy rather than elemental fire — burning hotter, adhering to targets longer, and resistant to mundane fire-suppression. The flames carry a minor terror effect that compounds the physical damage.

Mana Drain.name: Mana Drain
Mana Drain.description: Directly siphon magical energy from a target. The drained mana transfers to the caster. Effective as a combat denial tool — a mage who cannot cast is a different threat profile. The drain amount scales with how much the target has.

Delayed Blast Fireball.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
Delayed Blast Fireball.description: Plant a Fireball with a set detonation delay at a targeted location. The trigger can be time-based, proximity-based, or condition-based depending on the caster's specification. Significantly larger blast radius than a standard Fireball. Effective for pre-planned engagement setups where the blast point is known in advance.

Greater Summon.name: Greater Summon
Greater Summon.description: Summon a powerful extraplanar being to serve the caster for a limited duration. The summoned being's capability scales with the caster's tier and the preparation invested. At Tier 7, the summoned beings are a meaningful combat force. Requires significant mana and preparation time.

Hellfire Wall.name: Hellfire Wall
Hellfire Wall.description: Create a sustained barrier of demonic hellfire. The wall persists for a duration, blocking movement and dealing continuous damage to anything passing through it. Demiurge's area-denial tool. The flame cannot be extinguished by mundane or low-tier magical means.

Contingency.name: Contingency
Contingency.description: Pre-program a spell to activate automatically when a specified condition is met. The contingency spell is prepared in advance and stored until its trigger fires. Allows a caster to respond to conditions faster than conscious casting permits. Requires the trigger spell to be within the caster's normal capability.

Explosion.name: Explosion
Explosion.description: Create a massive magical detonation centred on a target point. The blast radius is large enough to engulf formations. Force and fire combined. One of Ainz Ooal Gown's combat spells — at full casting, this spell's detonation is visible from considerable distance. Few beings can survive a direct hit.

Shark Cyclone.name: Shark Cyclone
Shark Cyclone.description: Summon a cyclone of water embedded with conjured predatory sea creatures. The cyclone moves at the caster's direction, dealing sustained damage and disrupting formation cohesion. An Ainz Ooal Gown spell primarily effective at sea or near large water bodies. Effective on land as a disruption tool but reduced in potency without the water volume.

Time Reverse.name: Time Reverse
Time Reverse.description: A limited form of time manipulation applied to a single target. Reverses the target's biological state to a prior point in time — effectively undoing recent injury. Not a healing spell — the body literally returns to a prior state. Cannot reverse death. The mana cost is substantial. One of the rarer high-tier utility spells.

Create High Tier Undead.name: Create High Tier Undead
Create High Tier Undead.description: Raise a powerful undead being from a deceased creature. The resulting undead's tier correlates to the source material's quality and the caster's necromantic skill. Ainz regularly uses this to create undead forces. The undead produced at Tier 8 are significantly more capable than conventionally raised undead.

Black Hole.name: Black Hole
Black Hole.description: Generate a gravitational singularity at a target point that draws all matter within range toward it with irresistible force, crushing and shredding everything caught inside. Affects an area rather than a single target. The pull cannot be resisted by strength alone - escape requires teleportation or a counterspell of equivalent or higher tier. Environmental damage to terrain and structures is significant and permanent.

Meteor Fall.name: Meteor Fall
Meteor Fall.description: Call a magically accelerated mass of rock and metal from orbit at a target point. The impact is the weapon — the mass travels fast enough to create a localised shockwave on impact. Area of destruction is massive. Theoretically limited by availability of suitable mass in range.

Soul Burn.name: Soul Burn
Soul Burn.description: A Tier 10 spell that targets the target's soul directly through its physical form. The soul takes damage independent of physical resilience — beings with extraordinary physical protection are not meaningfully more resistant to this than others. One of Ainz's counter-tanking tools.

Grasp Heart.name: Grasp Heart
Grasp Heart.description: Reach into a target's body with precise magical force and crush their heart. Instant death on a failed resistance check. No effect on undead, constructs, or beings without a conventional cardiovascular system. Requires line of sight and calm enough conditions to execute cleanly. A surgical spell, not a battlefield one - used when discretion or certainty matters more than display.

Almighty Shooting Star Super.name: Almighty Shooting Star Super
Almighty Shooting Star Super.description: A Super-Tier spell that saturates a wide area with damage of multiple elemental types simultaneously. Resistances are relevant but cannot fully negate the attack because no single resistance covers all damage types deployed. The casting signature is unmistakable — anyone who survives the vicinity has seen a Supreme-tier casting.

Perfect Warrior.name: Perfect Warrior
Perfect Warrior.description: A unique transformation that converts Ainz Ooal Gown's magic-focused build to a physically optimal warrior configuration, applying every relevant physical combat enhancement simultaneously. The resulting form is the theoretically strongest possible physical fighter at max level. Used when fighting with greatswords rather than spells. Continuously drains mana while active and reduces mana recovery rate to one third of normal for the duration.

Sixfold Slash of Light.name: Sixfold Slash of Light
Sixfold Slash of Light.description: A sword technique that executes six simultaneous cuts from different angles in a single motion. The attacks cannot all be blocked -- the geometric angles prevent a single shield or parry position from covering all points. Requires full activation of the wielder's physical capabilities to execute.

Surging Momentum.name: Surging Momentum
Surging Momentum.description: A martial arts technique that converts forward movement energy into attack power. The faster the approach, the greater the strike force at impact. Requires committing to the charge — changing direction after initiating breaks the technique. Highly effective in corridors and straight approaches.

Limit Breaker.name: Limit Breaker
Limit Breaker.description: Override the body's natural protective limitations on physical output. Allows attack force beyond the normal ceiling at the cost of physical damage to the user. The technique is a trade — power now for injury later. Used when the outcome of the immediate engagement outweighs the cost of self-damage.

Field.name: Field
Field.description: A martial arts perception technique that extends awareness of intent beyond visual range. The user can detect aggressive intent from beings not yet in sight and anticipate attack directions before movement occurs. Requires sustained concentration.

See Through.name: See Through
See Through.description: A martial arts technique that allows the user to see through illusions and magical disguises. The technique is physical discipline applied to visual perception — it trains the user to read physical tells that magic cannot mask. Not effective against perfect illusions backed by extremely high-tier magic.

Thousand Blades.name: Thousand Blades
Thousand Blades.description: A dual-wielding martial art that generates attack iterations too fast to individually track. The defensive problem posed is statistical — a defender cannot block all attacks and must accept some percentage of impacts. Effective against single targets with high individual block capability.

Blood Drain.name: Blood Drain
Blood Drain.description: A vampiric ability that extracts blood from a target on physical contact. The drain is continuous while contact is maintained. The extracted blood heals the vampire proportional to the amount consumed.

Einherjar.name: Einherjar
Einherjar.description: Create a complete physical duplicate of the caster. The duplicate fights independently and has the same capability as the original at time of creation. Killing the duplicate does not harm Shalltear. Creating the Einherjar requires significant concentration at initiation.

Gate.name: Gate
Gate.description: Open a spatial gateway to a designated location regardless of physical distance. The gate is traversable in both directions. Closing the gate prematurely on a being in transit has predictable consequences. The Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown includes Gate access to Nazarick. Extremely high mana cost prevents casual use.

Beast Command.name: Beast Command
Beast Command.description: Aura Bella Fiora's primary ability — magical authority over beasts and magical creatures allowing instruction, bonding, and deployment. The creatures under her command retain their combat instincts while being directed. Her command capacity is far beyond what normal beast tamers can manage.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.description: Mare Bello Fiore's large-scale earth magic. Produces seismic disruption across a wide area. At full expression, this is continent-scale in theoretical reach — the practical cast produces localised disruption sufficient to collapse structures and reshape terrain. The ground does not return to its original state after the effect ends.

Perfect Mimic.name: Perfect Mimic
Perfect Mimic.description: Pandora's Actor's unique ability. Replicates the appearance, voice, personality, and abilities of any being he has sufficient observation data on. The mimic is complete — magical detection does not distinguish him from the original unless the detection specifically targets his Area Guardian nature. Requires data acquisition before use.

Dragon Strike.name: Dragon Strike
Dragon Strike.description: Sebas Tian's primary combat technique. A physical strike that draws on his dragon nature — the force delivered is proportional to a dragon's physical power, not a human butler's appearance.
